title: Learning to Navigate the Web
reason: Curriculum and meta-learning guided RL for the QWeb DQN agent that follows instructions and fills web forms on World of Bits tasks.

title: A Systematic Literature Review of Automated Techniques for Functional GUI Testing of Mobile Applications
reason: Systematic review of automated functional GUI testing tools for mobile apps; related GUI automation research that is not agent- or vision-model-driven.

title: DOM-Q-NET: Grounded RL on Structured Language
reason: RL architecture for web navigation over DOM trees with click and type actions, evaluated on MiniWoB.

title: Mobile App Tasks with Iterative Feedback (MoTIF): Addressing Task Feasibility in Interactive Visual Environments
reason: Releases MoTIF, a dataset of natural-language commands over many interactive mobile apps, including unsatisfiable requests with follow-up questions, to study task feasibility for app-operating agents.

title: AppBuddy: Learning to Accomplish Tasks in Mobile Apps via Reinforcement Learning
reason: RL framework and Gym-compatible platform where agents tap and type on on-screen elements to complete multi-step tasks in mobile apps.

title: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback
reason: Fine-tunes GPT-3 to answer long-form questions by searching and navigating a text-based web browser and collecting page references; a browsing QA agent rather than a general web-task agent.

title: CORNET: Learning Table Formatting Rules By Example
reason: Learns Excel conditional formatting rules from user-formatted example cells; spreadsheet automation by program synthesis rather than an agent operating the interface.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
reason: General reasoning-and-acting prompting method evaluated on QA through a Wikipedia API, on ALFWorld and on the WebShop web environment, which is one of several settings.

title: Fill in the Blank: Context-aware Automated Text Input Generation for Mobile GUI Testing
reason: LLM-based generation of context-aware text inputs for automated mobile GUI testing, integrated with GUI testing tools to reach more app pages and bugs.

title: FLAME: A small language model for spreadsheet formulas
reason: Trains a small transformer on Excel formulas for formula repair, completion and retrieval; spreadsheet formula assistance is office automation through formulas rather than agents operating a GUI.

title: Mobile User Interface Element Detection Via Adaptively Prompt Tuning
reason: Mobile UI element detection that fuses OCR text with visual features via adaptive prompt tuning on CLIP-based detectors, and releases the MUI-zh dataset.

title: Prompting Is All You Need: Automated Android Bug Replay with Large Language Models
reason: Uses prompted LLMs with few-shot chain-of-thought to reproduce Android app bugs by replaying the steps described in bug reports, a form of LLM-driven mobile app testing.

title: Unveiling the Tricks: Automated Detection of Dark Patterns in Mobile Applications
reason: Detects dark patterns in mobile app UIs by extracting UI properties with vision and text matching, plus a labeled UI dataset; UI analysis and critique rather than an agent.

title: AXNav: Replaying Accessibility Tests from Natural Language
reason: LLM agent combined with pixel-based UI understanding executes natural-language accessibility tests on mobile apps, including VoiceOver, and flags issues in chaptered videos.

title: CrashTranslator: Automatically Reproducing Mobile Application Crashes Directly from Stack Trace
reason: Uses an LLM plus RL-guided search to predict GUI exploration steps that reproduce Android app crashes from stack traces; LLM-driven mobile app testing evaluated on 58 apps.

title: Vision-Based Mobile App GUI Testing: A Survey
reason: Surveys vision-based mobile app GUI testing, where screenshot-based UI perception drives test generation and record-and-replay on app interfaces.

title: Make LLM a Testing Expert: Bringing Human-like Interaction to Mobile GUI Testing via Functionality-aware Decisions
reason: LLM-driven mobile GUI testing that feeds GUI page information to the model, executes generated actions with functionality-aware memory, and finds bugs in Google Play apps.

title: ProAgent: From Robotic Process Automation to Agentic Process Automation
reason: LLM agent that constructs and executes automation workflows from instructions, framed as agentic process automation beyond RPA; workflow automation rather than direct GUI operation.

title: UINav: A Practical Approach to Train On-Device Automation Agents
reason: Demonstration-based training of on-device agents that drive mobile app user interfaces, using a referee model for feedback and automatic demonstration augmentation.

title: UEyes: An Eye-Tracking Dataset across User Interface Types
reason: Releases eye-tracking data over webpage, desktop, mobile and poster UI screenshots and compares viewing behavior across UI types; this is visual-attention analysis of interfaces, not an agent.

title: Watch Out for Your Agents! Investigating Backdoor Threats to LLM-Based Agents
reason: Studies backdoor attacks on LLM agents, implemented on web shopping and tool-use tasks, so a web environment is one of two evaluation settings.

title: SheetAgent: Towards A Generalist Agent for Spreadsheet Reasoning and Manipulation via Large Language Models
reason: LLM agent and benchmark (SheetRM) for long-horizon spreadsheet manipulation through programmatic operations; office automation without GUI operation.

title: AutoGuide: Automated Generation and Selection of Context-Aware Guidelines for Large Language Model Agents
reason: Generates context-aware guidelines from offline experience for LLM agents; web navigation is the motivating domain and one of several evaluation domains, including real-world websites.

title: MineDreamer: Learning to Follow Instructions via Chain-of-Imagination for Simulated-World Control
reason: Minecraft instruction-following agent that imagines goal images and turns them into low-level keyboard-and-mouse actions; a game agent controlled through keyboard and mouse rather than a GUI or computer task.

title: Draw-and-Understand: Leveraging Visual Prompts to Enable MLLMs to Comprehend What You Want
reason: General visual-prompting MLLM framework whose 1.2M-sample instruction data and benchmark include mobile and web screenshots as one of several image domains.

title: Scaling Instructable Agents Across Many Simulated Worlds
reason: Instructable agents across 3D research environments and commercial video games that act through image observations and keyboard-and-mouse outputs, a generic computer interface.

title: UIClip: A Data-driven Model for Assessing User Interface Design
reason: CLIP-style model that scores UI screenshots for design quality and relevance, supporting UI code generation and design suggestions; UI critique rather than agent control.

title: Auto-Formula: Recommend Formulas in Spreadsheets using Contrastive Learning for Table Representations
reason: Recommends spreadsheet formulas for target cells by learning from similar enterprise spreadsheets; spreadsheet formula assistance, an office-automation precedent, without an agent operating the interface.

title: AutoScraper: A Progressive Understanding Web Agent for Web Scraper Generation
reason: LLM web agent that learns HTML structure across pages to generate reusable web scrapers; extraction-oriented web automation rather than interactive page operation.

title: FlowMind: Automatic Workflow Generation with LLMs
reason: LLM-generated API workflows proposed to extend robotic process automation to ad hoc requests, evaluated on a finance QA dataset; RPA-style process automation through APIs, not GUI operation.

title: Automating the Enterprise with Foundation Models
reason: ECLAIR uses multimodal foundation models in place of hand-coded RPA bots to understand and run enterprise workflows end to end; RPA-style automation, though the abstract never states GUI operation.

title: VLM Agents Generate Their Own Memories: Distilling Experience into Embodied Programs of Thought
reason: VLM agents turn imperfect trajectories into reusable abstracted examples; VisualWebArena is one of three detailed evaluation settings alongside TEACh and Ego4D.

title: SpreadsheetBench: Towards Challenging Real World Spreadsheet Manipulation
reason: Spreadsheet manipulation benchmark built from real Excel forum questions with multi-file test cases; office application automation by LLMs, with no GUI operation described.

title: OpenHands: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
reason: Open platform for generalist agents that write code, use a command line and browse the web, evaluated on SWE-bench, WebArena and other tasks, so web browsing is one material setting.

title: MindSearch: Mimicking Human Minds Elicits Deep AI Searcher
reason: Multi-agent deep-search framework that plans sub-questions and reads content from hundreds of web pages found through search engines; web information seeking rather than page operation.

title: Agent Q: Advanced Reasoning and Learning for Autonomous AI Agents
reason: Combines MCTS, self-critique and off-policy DPO to train web agents, evaluated on WebShop and on live real-world booking websites.

title: MM1.5: Methods, Analysis & Insights from Multimodal LLM Fine-tuning
reason: General multimodal LLM family whose abstract includes a dedicated MM1.5-UI variant tailored to mobile UI understanding.

title: ExACT: Teaching AI Agents to Explore with Reflective-MCTS and Exploratory Learning
reason: Reflective MCTS test-time search plus exploratory learning that distills search into VLM web agents, evaluated on VisualWebArena.

title: Large Language Models Empowered Personalized Web Agents
reason: Personalized web agent benchmark (PersonalWAB) and memory-based alignment method (PUMA); agents complete web tasks through Web function calls rather than page-level GUI actions.

title: Infogent: An Agent-Based Framework for Web Information Aggregation
reason: Modular web agent for information aggregation, including a setting that navigates the browser from webpage screenshots, evaluated on AssistantBench as well as FRAMES.

title: WorkflowLLM: Enhancing Workflow Orchestration Capability of Large Language Models
reason: Fine-tunes LLMs to orchestrate application workflows written as code from Apple Shortcuts and RoutineHub over 1,503 app APIs; API-level process automation rather than GUI control.

title: Automated Test Transfer Across Android Apps Using Large Language Models
reason: Uses LLMs to migrate end-to-end UI tests between Android apps with similar functions; LLM-driven mobile GUI testing.

title: BigDocs: An Open Dataset for Training Multimodal Models on Document and Code Tasks
reason: Releases a large multimodal document and code dataset whose benchmark includes GUI reasoning and Screenshot2HTML tasks; screen understanding is a material but not central part.

title: CAD-Assistant: Tool-Augmented VLLMs as Generic CAD Task Solvers
reason: Tool-augmented VLLM agent that drives the FreeCAD application through its Python API for CAD tasks; desktop application automation via scripts rather than GUI control.

title: Beyond Pass or Fail: Multi-Dimensional Benchmarking of Foundation Models for Goal-based Mobile UI Navigation
reason: Sphinx benchmark for multi-dimensional evaluation of foundation models on goal-based mobile UI navigation, using Google Play apps and WeChat UI test cases.

title: Learn-by-interact: A Data-Centric Framework for Self-Adaptive Agents in Realistic Environments
reason: Synthesizes agent trajectories from documentation with backward construction, evaluated mostly on web and desktop environments (WebArena, OSWorld, Spider2-V) plus SWE-bench.

title: R2D2: Remembering, Replaying and Dynamic Decision Making with a Reflective Agentic Memory
reason: Web agent framework that combines a replay-buffer map of visited pages with reflective error analysis, evaluated on WebArena.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Interactive LLM Agents
reason: RL method (LOOP) for agents that operate the multi-app AppWorld environment through direct API calls; app automation through APIs without a GUI.

title: RWKV-UI: UI Understanding with Enhanced Perception and Reasoning
reason: RWKV-based VLM for high-resolution web UI understanding that uses layout detection and chain-of-thought visual prompts.

title: InSTA: Towards Internet-Scale Training For Agents
reason: Builds an LLM pipeline that proposes tasks on 150k websites, collects and judges web-agent trajectories, and trains small web navigation agents on the resulting data.

title: Scaling Autonomous Agents via Automatic Reward Modeling And Planning
reason: Learns reward models from random environment exploration to guide LLM agent planning; online shopping is named among its decision-making domains alongside scientific reasoning and math.

title: UXAgent: An LLM Agent-Based Usability Testing Framework for Web Design
reason: Uses LLM agents with a universal browser connector to simulate many users acting on a target website for usability testing, reporting their actions, reasoning and recordings.

title: Magma: A Foundation Model for Multimodal AI Agents
reason: Multimodal agent foundation model pretrained with Set-of-Mark labels on clickable GUI elements, reporting UI navigation results alongside robot manipulation.

title: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report
reason: General vision-language model report that highlights acting as a visual agent for operating computers and mobile devices among its core capabilities.

title: Advancing Language Multi-Agent Learning with Credit Re-Assignment for Interactive Environment Generalization
reason: Multi-agent RL framework for UI agents with LLM-assigned process rewards, aimed at generalizing across mobile-operation and web-browsing environments.

title: MobileSteward: Integrating Multiple App-Oriented Agents with Self-Evolution to Automate Cross-App Instructions
reason: Multi-agent mobile phone agent framework with app-specialized agents and self-evolving memory for cross-app instructions, plus a real-device cross-app benchmark.

title: WebGames: Challenging General-Purpose Web-Browsing AI Agents
reason: Hermetic benchmark of 50+ browser interaction challenges for general-purpose web-browsing agents, comparing computer-use and vision-language models with humans.

title: Language Models can Self-Improve at State-Value Estimation for Better Search
reason: Self-taught lookahead value models for search, motivated by and mainly evaluated on web agent tasks, with generalization to multi-hop QA and math puzzles.

title: MIP against Agent: Malicious Image Patches Hijacking Multimodal OS Agents
reason: Adversarial screen patches, e.g. in wallpapers or social posts, that hijack screenshot-driven OS agents into harmful mouse and keyboard actions; security of computer-use agents.

title: WebNav: An Intelligent Agent for Voice-Controlled Web Navigation
reason: Voice-controlled multimodal web navigation agent that combines screenshots with DOM labeling to execute actions on web interfaces.

title: JARVIS-VLA: Post-Training Large-Scale Vision Language Models to Play Visual Games with Keyboards and Mouse
reason: Post-trains VLMs into vision-language-action agents that play Minecraft from visual input with keyboard and mouse actions; game play through keyboard and mouse control rather than GUI or computer tasks.

title: Agents in the Sandbox: End-to-End Crash Bug Reproduction for Minecraft
reason: A vision-based LLM agent with a custom macro API executes bug-reproduction steps inside Minecraft and is compared with computer-use model baselines; vision-driven game testing rather than GUI app work.

title: Inducing Programmatic Skills for Agentic Tasks
reason: Web agents induce, verify and reuse program-based skills that combine low-level clicks into reusable routines, evaluated on WebArena and cross-website transfer.

title: Kimi-VL Technical Report
reason: General MoE vision-language model whose abstract reports computer-use results on OSWorld and GUI grounding on ScreenSpot-Pro alongside broad multimodal benchmarks.

title: AgentA/B: Automated and Scalable Web A/BTesting with Interactive LLM Agents
reason: Persona-driven LLM agents navigate live webpages, searching, clicking, filtering and buying, to simulate web A/B tests at scale, an agent-driven web testing system.

title: REAL: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents on Deterministic Simulations of Real Websites
reason: Benchmark of deterministic replicas of 11 real websites with 112 tasks for evaluating web agents on retrieval and state-changing actions.

title: WebLists: Extracting Structured Information From Complex Interactive Websites Using Executable LLM Agents
reason: Benchmark of structured data-extraction tasks that require web agents to navigate and configure interactive sites, plus an agent that turns its execution into replayable CSS-selector programs.

title: WebGen-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Generating Interactive and Functional Websites from Scratch
reason: Benchmark for code agents that generate multi-file websites; functionality is checked by a web-navigation agent executing UI test operations, so it is UI code generation with agent-driven web testing.

title: AgentVigil: Generic Black-Box Red-teaming for Indirect Prompt Injection against LLM Agents
reason: MCTS-guided fuzzing that finds indirect prompt injections against LLM agents, tested on AgentDojo, the VWA-adv web-agent benchmark and real web navigation toward malicious URLs.

title: Leveraging Vision-Language Models for Visual Grounding and Analysis of Automotive UI
reason: Fine-tunes a VLM for grounding and evaluating automotive infotainment UIs with a new annotated dataset, and also reports ScreenSpot GUI grounding results.

title: Seed1.5-VL Technical Report
reason: Technical report of a general vision-language foundation model whose abstract highlights GUI control results against OpenAI CUA and Claude as a material agent capability.

title: InfantAgent-Next: A Multimodal Generalist Agent for Automated Computer Interaction
reason: Modular generalist computer-interaction agent combining tool-based and pure-vision agents, evaluated on OSWorld as well as GAIA and SWE-Bench.

title: Group-in-Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
reason: Group-based RL algorithm with step-level credit assignment for LLM agents, evaluated on WebShop together with ALFWorld and search QA.

title: WebInject: Prompt Injection Attack to Web Agents
reason: Prompt injection attack that optimizes pixel perturbations on rendered webpages so that screenshot-based MLLM web agents perform attacker-chosen actions.

title: Mobile-Agent-V: A Video-Guided Approach for Effortless and Efficient Operational Knowledge Injection in Mobile Automation
reason: Injects operational knowledge from demonstration videos into a mobile automation agent and adds a benchmark for knowledge-dependent mobile tasks.

title: MedBrowseComp: Benchmarking Medical Deep Research and Computer Use
reason: Benchmark of multi-hop medical questions that agents answer by retrieving from live domain knowledge bases, framed as testing deep-research and computer-use systems.

title: AutoData: A Multi-Agent System for Open Web Data Collection
reason: Multi-agent LLM system that collects datasets from live websites given a natural-language request, with a new web data collection benchmark; web scraping rather than interactive page operation.

title: TransBench: Breaking Barriers for Transferable Graphical User Interface Agents in Dynamic Digital Environments
reason: TransBench evaluates GUI agent grounding transfer across app versions, platforms (iOS, Android, Web) and applications.

title: Training LLM-Based Agents with Synthetic Self-Reflected Trajectories and Partial Masking
reason: General agent training with self-reflected synthetic trajectories and partial masking, evaluated on WebShop alongside ALFWorld and SciWorld.

title: SPA-RL: Reinforcing LLM Agents via Stepwise Progress Attribution
reason: General stepwise reward-attribution RL for LLM agents, evaluated on WebShop alongside ALFWorld and VirtualHome.

title: Agent-Environment Alignment via Automated Interface Generation
reason: Generates enriched agent-environment interfaces to reduce misalignment, evaluated across embodied, web navigation and tool-use domains.

title: Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Visual Reasoning
reason: Visually grounded RL for general VLM reasoning, evaluated in part on ScreenSpot and VisualWebArena with notable gains in localizing small GUI elements.

title: Agent-X: Evaluating Deep Multimodal Reasoning in Vision-Centric Agentic Tasks
reason: Vision-centric agent benchmark with tool use and step-level grading whose six environments include web browsing alongside driving, surveillance, sports and math; web is one material setting among several.

title: ResTest: Targeted Coverage of Residual Not-Covered Code Using Large Language Models for Web GUI Testing
reason: Coverage-guided LLM web GUI testing in which an LLM-driven GUI agent executes inferred untested functionalities on web applications.

title: FormFactory: An Interactive Benchmarking Suite for Multimodal Form-Filling Agents
reason: Introduces an interactive web-based benchmark for multimodal agents that fill online forms by matching instructions to on-screen fields; evaluated MLLMs stay below 5% accuracy.

title: WebChoreArena: Evaluating Web Browsing Agents on Realistic Tedious Web Tasks
reason: Extension of WebArena with 532 tedious web chores that stress memory and calculation for web browsing agents.

title: MiMo-VL Technical Report
reason: General vision-language model report that explicitly claims strong GUI grounding results on OSWorld-G against specialized GUI models.

title: Deep Research Bench: Evaluating AI Web Research Agents
reason: Benchmark of multi-step web research tasks using a frozen corpus of scraped pages that agents search and read; deep-research browsing rather than GUI operation.

title: Build the web for agents, not agents for the web
reason: Position paper arguing that web agents should use purpose-built agentic web interfaces (AWI) instead of human-oriented pages, with design principles for agent navigation of websites.

title: FormGym: Doing Paperwork with Agents
reason: Form-filling benchmark on document images for computer agents, evaluating VLAs and GUI agents and adding a field-localization tool to help them place text.

title: Doc2Agent: Scalable Generation of Tool-Using Agents from API Documentation
reason: Generates validated Python tools from API documentation for tool agents; WebArena is one material evaluation setting alongside real-world and scientific APIs.

title: Agent-RewardBench: Towards a Unified Benchmark for Reward Modeling across Perception, Planning, and Safety in Real-World Multimodal Agents
reason: Step-level reward-model benchmark for multimodal agents covering perception, planning and safety, with web navigation named among scenarios alongside embodied tasks.

title: Mind2Web 2: Evaluating Agentic Search with Agent-as-a-Judge
reason: Benchmark of long-horizon agentic search tasks that require live web browsing, with an agent-as-a-judge evaluator for deep-research systems.

title: GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-Thinking: Towards Versatile Multimodal Reasoning with Scalable Reinforcement Learning
reason: General VLM family trained with curriculum RL; the abstract lists GUI-based agents among its target tasks and highlights competitive GUI-agent benchmark results.

title: WebSynthesis: World-Model-Guided MCTS for Efficient WebUI-Trajectory Synthesis
reason: WebSynthesis uses a learned web world model and MCTS to synthesize web UI trajectories for training web agents.

title: A Training-Free, Task-Agnostic Framework for Enhancing MLLM Performance on High-Resolution Images
reason: Training-free two-stage method for MLLMs on high-resolution images, with 4K GUI grounding as a main evaluation alongside 4K and 8K perception benchmarks.

title: Let's Think in Two Steps: Mitigating Agreement Bias in MLLMs with Self-Grounded Verification
reason: Studies agreement bias in MLLM verifiers for web navigation and computer use, proposes self-grounded verification, and releases an improved VisualWebArena.

title: Screen2AX: Vision-Based Approach for Automatic macOS Accessibility Generation
reason: Screen2AX builds macOS accessibility trees from screenshots via UI element detection, releases datasets and a desktop agent benchmark, and reports ScreenSpot gains.

title: General Agentic Planning Through Simulative Reasoning with World Models
reason: World-model simulative planning architecture for agents, evaluated entirely on web-browser tasks (constrained navigation, information aggregation, instruction following) against an open-web agent baseline.

title: Measuring Harmfulness of Computer-Using Agents
reason: Introduces CUAHarm, 104 realistic misuse tasks in a sandbox with verifiable rewards, to measure whether computer-using agents carry out harmful actions, and tests LM monitors of CUA actions.

title: HarmonyGuard: Toward Safety and Utility in Web Agents via Adaptive Policy Enhancement and Dual-Objective Optimization
reason: Multi-agent framework that jointly improves policy compliance and task completion for web agents acting in open web environments.

title: VeriWeb: Verifiable Long-Chain Web Benchmark for Agentic Information-Seeking
reason: Benchmark of long-chain web information-seeking tasks with subtask-level verification and human trajectory demonstrations; it targets browsing research agents rather than GUI task execution.

title: OdysseyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Complex Office Application Workflows
reason: OdysseyBench evaluates agents on long-horizon workflows across Word, Excel, PDF, email and calendar apps; office application automation whose interaction interface is not described.

title: MM-BrowseComp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Browsing Agents
reason: Benchmark in the BrowseComp line for multimodal browsing agents that must extract evidence from web images and videos during deep search.

title: Structuring GUI Elements through Vision Language Models: Towards Action Space Generation
reason: IoU-augmented maximum likelihood training helps MLLMs output precise UI element coordinates for GUI element structuring and screen understanding.

title: WebMMU: A Benchmark for Multimodal Multilingual Website Understanding and Code Generation
reason: Multilingual benchmark testing MLLMs on website screenshot QA with element grounding and UI comprehension, plus HTML/CSS/JS editing and mockup-to-code, aimed at future web agents.

title: DashboardQA: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Question Answering on Interactive Dashboards
reason: Benchmark of interactive Tableau dashboards on which vision-language GUI agents, including OpenAI CUA, must ground elements, plan interaction trajectories and answer questions.

title: InternVL3.5: Advancing Open-Source Multimodal Models in Versatility, Reasoning, and Efficiency
reason: General open-source MLLM family with cascade RL and efficiency techniques; the abstract highlights GUI interaction as a newly supported capability alongside embodied agency.

title: Reliable Weak-to-Strong Monitoring of LLM Agents
reason: Red-teams monitors of covert agent misbehavior and adds CUA-SHADE-Arena, a new environment built on TheAgentCompany for computer-use agents.

title: SWIRL: A Staged Workflow for Interleaved Reinforcement Learning in Mobile GUI Control
reason: Trains a multi-agent mobile GUI controller with staged interleaved RL, pairing a planning navigator with an action-grounding interactor, and evaluates it on GUI benchmarks.

title: MMSearch-Plus: Benchmarking Provenance-Aware Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents
reason: Benchmarks multimodal browsing agents on 311 tasks needing visual cues and image/text search, with a set-of-mark agent framework; failures include locating the relevant webpages.

title: PG-Agent: An Agent Powered by Page Graph
reason: Converts GUI episodes into page graphs and retrieves perception guidelines from them to guide a multi-agent GUI agent on unseen scenarios across GUI benchmarks.

title: Are LLM Agents the New RPA? A Comparative Study with RPA Across Enterprise Workflows
reason: Compares a commercial computer-use agent with UiPath RPA on enterprise data entry, monitoring and document extraction, measuring speed, reliability and development effort.

title: Instruction Agent: Enhancing Agent with Expert Demonstration
reason: GUI agent that extracts step instructions from a single expert demonstration and follows them with verifier and backtracker modules, handling pop-ups and solving OSWorld tasks that top agents fail.

title: Agentic Lybic: Multi-Agent Execution System with Tiered Reasoning and Orchestration
reason: FSM-orchestrated multi-agent desktop automation system with GUI and code workers plus quality gating, evaluated on OSWorld.

title: ReSum: Unlocking Long-Horizon Search Intelligence via Context Summarization
reason: ReSum periodically summarizes context so LLM web agents can keep exploring on knowledge-intensive search tasks, with a GRPO variant; web information seeking rather than GUI control.

title: Mano Technical Report
reason: Presents Mano, a GUI agent trained with SFT plus offline and online RL using a simulated environment for data generation, with results on Mind2Web and OSWorld.

title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Step Rewards
reason: General agentic RL credit-assignment method with implicit step rewards, evaluated on WebShop alongside VisualSokoban and SOTOPIA.

title: Recon-Act: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Browser-Use System via Web Reconnaissance, Tool Generation, and Task Execution
reason: Multi-agent browser-use agent that learns reusable tools by contrasting failed and successful web trajectories, reporting top results on VisualWebArena.

title: UISim: An Interactive Image-Based UI Simulator for Dynamic Mobile Environments
reason: Image-based mobile UI simulator that predicts next-screen layouts and renders them, supporting UI testing, synthetic data and agent training.

title: D-Artemis: A Deliberative Cognitive Framework for Mobile GUI Multi-Agents
reason: Training-free deliberative multi-agent framework for mobile GUI agents with tip retrieval, pre-execution checks and reflection, evaluated on AndroidWorld and ScreenSpot-V2.

title: WebGen-Agent: Enhancing Interactive Website Generation with Multi-Level Feedback and Step-Level Reinforcement Learning
reason: Website-generation agent refined by screenshot critiques and GUI-agent testing scores, which also serve as Step-GRPO rewards; UI code generation with GUI-agent feedback.

title: GUI-Shepherd: Reliable Process Reward and Verification for Long-Sequence GUI Tasks
reason: Trains a process reward model on 52k annotated GUI interactions to give step-level rewards and verification for GUI agents, improving AndroidWorld via online PPO and AndroidControl offline.

title: Flash-Searcher: Fast and Effective Web Agents via DAG-Based Parallel Execution
reason: Deep-search web agent framework that runs tool calls as a parallel DAG, evaluated on the BrowseComp and xbench-DeepSearch browsing benchmarks.

title: Graph2Eval: Automatic Multimodal Task Generation for Agents via Knowledge Graphs
reason: Knowledge-graph framework that generates agent evaluation tasks, covering web-interaction tasks for web agents alongside document-understanding tasks for RAG agents.

title: Say One Thing, Do Another? Diagnosing Reasoning-Execution Gaps in VLM-Powered Mobile-Use Agents
reason: Measures whether chain-of-thought rationales of VLM mobile GUI agents agree with their executed actions, exposing reasoning and execution gaps across mobile interaction tasks.

title: FocusAgent: Simple Yet Effective Ways of Trimming the Large Context of Web Agents
reason: Trims web agents' accessibility-tree observations with a small LLM retriever, shrinking context and reducing banner and pop-up injection success on WorkArena and WebArena.

title: Learning Efficient Guardrails for Compliance
reason: PolicyGuardBench and the PolicyGuard guardrail detect policy violations in web agent trajectories, including early detection from trajectory prefixes.

title: Cross-Modal Content Optimization for Steering Web Agent Preferences
reason: Black-box attack that jointly perturbs a listing's images and text to steer VLM-based web agents' choices in movie and e-commerce selection tasks; a security study of web agents.

title: Understanding User Experiences of Computer Use Agents: Design Space and Opportunities for Building Agent UX Prototypes
reason: Maps the user-experience design space of computer-use agents and builds a browser-based probe for prototyping agent UX on websites.

title: 3Dify: a Framework for Procedural 3D-CG Generation Assisted by LLMs Using MCP and RAG
reason: LLM framework that automates 3D content-creation tools through MCP and falls back to a computer-using agent for GUI operation; GUI control is one component of a 3D generation system.

title: Watch and Learn: Learning to Use Computers from Online Videos
reason: Turns internet screen-recording videos into labeled UI action trajectories with an inverse-dynamics model, improving computer-use agents on OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena.

title: GUISpector: An MLLM Agent Framework for Automated Verification of Natural Language Requirements in GUI Prototypes
reason: Uses an MLLM agent that interacts with GUI prototypes to check whether natural-language requirements are met and returns developer feedback, a form of LLM-agent-driven GUI testing.

title: Demystifying deep search: a holistic evaluation with hint-free multi-hop questions and factorised metrics
reason: Deep-search benchmark with hint-free multi-hop questions and a controlled Wikipedia sandbox that traces web agents' actions, plus an evidence-tracking agent workflow; a browsing research-agent resource.

title: A Multimodal GUI Architecture for Interfacing with LLM-Based Conversational Assistants
reason: Architecture exposing an application's GUI navigation graph and view-level tools to speech-enabled LLM assistants through MCP for voice accessibility; GUI control goes through structured tools rather than screen perception.

title: Your Harness is Not Secure: Benchmarking Real-world Threat of Command Line Interface Agent
reason: ATT&CK-aligned benchmark of OS-level misuse by CLI agents such as Claude Code and Gemini CLI in a multi-host sandbox; terminal agents operating real systems, with no GUI involved.

title: ALLOY: Generating Reusable Agent Workflows from User Demonstration
reason: Lets users create LLM web agents from demonstrations that become editable, generalizable workflows, evaluated in a user study on complex web tasks.

title: WebRouter: Query-specific Router via Variational Information Bottleneck for Cost-sensitive Web Agent
reason: Cost-aware LLM router for web agents trained with a variational information bottleneck, evaluated on WebVoyager websites.

title: Detect Anything via Next Point Prediction
reason: General MLLM detector based on next-point prediction whose benchmarked capabilities include GUI grounding alongside detection, referring and OCR.

title: ReUseIt: Synthesizing Reusable AI Agent Workflows for Web Automation
reason: Synthesizes reusable workflows with execution guards from web agents' attempts to automate repetitive web tasks, with a user study.

title: WebAggregator: Enhancing Compositional Reasoning Capabilities of Deep Research Agent Foundation Models
reason: Synthesizes compositional QA data from 50K websites to train deep-research agents that explore web pages, evaluated on GAIA, WebWalkerQA and XBench.

title: State Your Intention to Steer Your Attention: An AI Assistant for Intentional Digital Living
reason: LLM assistant reads screenshots, window titles and URLs of a user's computer activity to nudge them toward a stated goal; it understands the screen but does not operate the interface.

title: Agentic Entropy-Balanced Policy Optimization
reason: Agentic RL algorithm for tool-using web search agents, evaluated on GAIA, HLE and the WebWalker browsing benchmark.

title: LLMs as Scalable, General-Purpose Simulators For Evolving Digital Agent Training
reason: Uses LLMs as UI-state simulators to synthesize training trajectories for digital agents, evaluated on WebArena and AndroidWorld.

title: PolySkill: Learning Generalizable Skills Through Polymorphic Abstraction
reason: Polymorphic skill abstraction lets web agents learn reusable skills that generalize across websites, evaluated on Mind2Web and unseen sites.

title: Beyond Pipelines: A Survey of the Paradigm Shift toward Model-Native Agentic AI
reason: Survey of RL-driven model-native agentic AI that treats the GUI agent as one of two major application areas alongside deep research agents.

title: Genesis: Evolving Attack Strategies for LLM Web Agent Red-Teaming
reason: Evolving red-teaming framework that generates adversarial injections against LLM web agents across web tasks.

title: CUARewardBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Reward Models on Computer-using Agent
reason: Benchmark of annotated computer-use agent trajectories for evaluating outcome and process reward models, plus a unanimous prompt-ensemble method for more reliable CUA reward judgments.

title: See, Think, Act: Online Shopper Behavior Simulation with VLM Agents
reason: Trains VLM agents with SFT and RL to predict online shoppers' web actions from page screenshots, HTML and action history on the OPeRA dataset.

title: SheetBrain: A Neuro-Symbolic Agent for Accurate Reasoning over Complex and Large Spreadsheets
reason: Spreadsheet agent that answers questions about and manipulates large workbooks through a Python sandbox and Excel helper toolkit; script-based office automation without GUI control.

title: ColorAgent: Building A Robust, Personalized, and Interactive OS Agent
reason: OS agent trained with step-wise RL and self-evolving data plus a multi-agent framework, reaching high success on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab.

title: Branch-and-Browse: Efficient and Controllable Web Exploration with Tree-Structured Reasoning and Action Memory
reason: Web agent framework with tree-structured subtask exploration, web state replay and page action memory, evaluated on WebArena.

title: GhostEI-Bench: Do Mobile Agents Resilience to Environmental Injection in Dynamic On-Device Environments?
reason: Benchmark of environmental injection attacks (deceptive overlays, spoofed notifications) on mobile GUI agents inside live Android emulators, with screenshot-based failure analysis.

title: Mixing Importance with Diversity: Joint Optimization for KV Cache Compression in Large Vision-Language Models
reason: KV cache compression method for LVLMs that reports notable gains on GUI grounding tasks alongside general multimodal benchmarks.

title: Mitigating Coordinate Prediction Bias from Positional Encoding Failures
reason: Training-free decoding correction for MLLM coordinate bias caused by positional encodings, evaluated on the ScreenSpot-Pro GUI grounding benchmark.

title: WebATLAS: An LLM Agent with Experience-Driven Memory and Action Simulation
reason: Memory-augmented LLM web agent with look-ahead action simulation, reaching 63% success on WebArena-Lite.

title: Agent Data Protocol: Unifying Datasets for Diverse, Effective Fine-tuning of LLM Agents
reason: Unifies 13 agent datasets (tool use, web browsing, coding, SWE) into one format for SFT; browsing benchmarks are one material evaluation setting among several non-GUI ones.

title: GUI Knowledge Bench: Revealing the Knowledge Gap of VLMs in GUI Tasks
reason: Benchmark probing VLM knowledge of GUI widgets, interactions and procedures across six platforms and 292 apps, linked to GUI agent task success.

title: Scaling Agent Learning via Experience Synthesis
reason: General framework that synthesizes experience with a reasoning-based environment model for RL of LLM agents across several environments, with WebArena as a material web setting.

title: Promoting Sustainable Web Agents: Benchmarking and Estimating Energy Consumption through Empirical and Theoretical Analysis
reason: Estimates and benchmarks the energy and CO2 cost of web agents such as Operator and Mariner, arguing for energy metrics in web-agent evaluation.

title: WebVIA: A Web-based Vision-Language Agentic Framework for Interactive and Verifiable UI-to-Code Generation
reason: Interactive UI-to-code framework where an exploration agent steps through web UI states and a validator checks interactivity of generated HTML; primarily UI code generation.

title: AgentPRM: Process Reward Models for LLM Agents via Step-Wise Promise and Progress
reason: Process reward model for LLM agents, motivated by and evaluated on agent tasks such as web shopping and browser navigation among others.

title: TaskSense: Cognitive Chain Modeling and Difficulty Estimation for GUI Tasks
reason: Models GUI task difficulty as chains of cognitive steps extracted from execution traces and uses it to expose capability gaps of GUI agents.

title: STEP: Success-Rate-Aware Trajectory-Efficient Policy Optimization
reason: Success-rate-aware, step-level policy optimization for multi-turn agent RL, evaluated on OSWorld and AndroidWorld.

title: Can We Stop Malicious AI? KILLBENCH: A Benchmark for External AI Kill Switch Feasibility
reason: Benchmark of external prompt-style kill-switch payloads meant to halt maliciously operating web agents; safety and control of web agents.

title: AppSelectBench: Application-Level Tool Selection Benchmark
reason: Benchmarks whether computer-using agents choose the right desktop application for a user task, covering 100 desktop applications and over 100k generated tasks.

title: BrowseSafe: Understanding and Preventing Prompt Injection Within AI Browser Agents
reason: Benchmark of prompt injections embedded in realistic HTML payloads for AI browser agents, with an evaluation of existing and layered defenses.

title: Real-Time Procedural Learning From Experience for AI Agents
reason: Procedural memory that retrieves past state-action-result exemplars matched on the current state, evaluated on the REAL web browsing benchmark.

title: MCP vs RAG vs NLWeb vs HTML: A Comparison of the Effectiveness and Efficiency of Different Agent Interfaces to the Web (Technical Report)
reason: Compares LLM web agents using HTML browsing, RAG, MCP and NLWeb interfaces on a testbed of simulated e-shops for product search, comparison and checkout tasks.

title: WebOperator: Action-Aware Tree Search for Autonomous Agents in Web Environment
reason: Action-aware tree search web agent with safe backtracking and action filtering, evaluated on WebArena and WebVoyager.

title: SmartSnap: Proactive Evidence Seeking for Self-Verifying Agents
reason: Self-verifying GUI agents that curate snapshot evidence of task completion for an LLM judge, trained with agentic RL on mobile tasks.

title: DECEPTICON: How Dark Patterns Manipulate Web Agents
reason: Introduces DECEPTICON, an environment of 700 web navigation tasks containing dark patterns, and shows that deceptive UI designs steer web agent trajectories while existing defenses fail to stop them.

title: Permission Manifests for Web Agents
reason: Proposes a robots.txt-style permission manifest through which websites declare which interactions LLM web agents may perform, a governance mechanism for web agents.

title: Agent-Dice: Disentangling Knowledge Updates via Geometric Consensus for Agent Continual Learning
reason: Parameter-fusion continual-learning method for LLM agents that is evaluated on GUI agent tasks alongside tool-use agent domains.

title: FronTalk: Benchmarking Front-End Development as Conversational Code Generation with Multi-Modal Feedback
reason: Benchmarks multi-turn front-end code generation from sketches, mockups and screenshots, using a web agent that explores the generated sites to evaluate them; UI code generation rather than GUI operation.

title: Beyond Clicking:A Step Towards Generalist GUI Grounding via Text Dragging
reason: Extends GUI grounding from clicking to text dragging with the GUI-Drag dataset and ScreenDrag benchmark while keeping ScreenSpot and OSWorld-G performance.

title: V2P: Visual Attention Calibration for GUI Grounding via Background Suppression and Center Peaking
reason: GUI grounding method with background-suppression attention and Gaussian center-peaked targets, evaluated on ScreenSpot-v2 and ScreenSpot-Pro.

title: Terminal-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks in Command Line Interfaces
reason: Benchmark of 89 hard, realistic tasks for agents working in computer terminal environments, with human solutions and tests; a terminal-agent resource without GUI interaction.

title: Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI): Architectures, Taxonomies, and Evaluation of Large Language Model Agents
reason: Survey and taxonomy of LLM agents whose abstract explicitly covers native computer use, web navigation and digital operating-system environments alongside other agent settings.

title: Computer Environments Elicit General Agentic Intelligence in LLMs
reason: Gives LLMs a minimal code-sandbox computer with file management, resource access and code execution, showing gains on general tasks and training via sandbox RL; computer use through code and files, not a GUI.

title: MalURLBench: A Benchmark Evaluating Agents' Vulnerabilities When Processing Web URLs
reason: Security benchmark for LLM-based web agents that may accept disguised malicious URLs leading to unsafe webpages, with an analysis of attack factors and a lightweight URL guard defense.

title: Me-Agent: A Personalized Mobile Agent with Two-Level User Habit Learning for Enhanced Interaction
reason: Personalized LLM mobile agent with a preference reward model and hierarchical app-specific memory, plus the User FingerTip benchmark of ambiguous daily phone instructions.

title: SSL: Sweet Spot Learning for Differentiated Guidance in Agentic Optimization
reason: Tiered reward scheme for agent RL whose experiments include GUI perception with distance-based grounding rewards alongside planning and reasoning benchmarks.

title: Okara: Detection and Attribution of TLS Man-in-the-Middle Vulnerabilities in Android Apps with Foundation Models
reason: Uses foundation-model-driven GUI agents to explore Android apps at scale for TLS man-in-the-middle vulnerability detection, an agent-driven app testing pipeline.

title: SimGym: Traffic-Grounded Browser Agents for Offline A/B Testing in E-Commerce
reason: LLM agents operating a live browser act as traffic-grounded synthetic buyers to run offline A/B tests of e-commerce UI changes.

title: PlanViz: Evaluating Planning-Oriented Image Generation and Editing for Computer-Use Tasks
reason: Benchmarks unified multimodal models on image generation and editing for tasks framed as computer use, including a web and UI display subtask; models generate interface imagery rather than operate interfaces.

title: Where Not to Learn: Prior-Aligned Training with Subset-based Attribution Constraints
reason: General attribution-prior alignment training method evaluated on image classification and on click decisions of MLLM-based GUI agents.

title: Do Multi-Agents Dream of Electric Screens? Achieving Perfect Accuracy on AndroidWorld Through Task Decomposition
reason: Multi-agent mobile GUI system with task decomposition, verified text input and loop detection that solves every AndroidWorld task.

title: When Benign Inputs Lead to Severe Harms: Eliciting Unsafe Unintended Behaviors of Computer-Use Agents
reason: AutoElicit iteratively rewrites benign instructions to expose harmful unintended actions by computer-use agents such as Claude and Operator during OS workflows.

title: MUZZLE: Adaptive Agentic Red-Teaming of Web Agents Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks
reason: Adaptive agentic red-teaming framework that discovers indirect prompt-injection attacks against web agents acting on real web applications.

title: LHAW: Controllable Underspecification for Long-Horizon Tasks
reason: Pipeline that turns long-horizon tasks into underspecified variants to test clarification seeking, drawing on TheAgentCompany web-based workplace tasks alongside SWE-Bench Pro and MCP-Atlas.

title: ICA: Information-Aware Credit Assignment for Visually Grounded Long-Horizon Information-Seeking Agents
reason: Credit assignment for deep-search web agents that read fetched webpages as rendered snapshots, evaluated on BrowseComp, GAIA and related benchmarks.

title: Blind Gods and Broken Screens: Architecting a Secure, Intent-Centric Mobile Agent Operating System
reason: Analyzes security flaws of screen-based mobile agents such as visual spoofing and prompt injection, and proposes a secure agent OS evaluated on MobileSafetyBench.

title: How Smart Is Your GUI Agent? A Framework for the Future of Software Interaction
reason: Position framework that defines six autonomy levels for GUI agents operating web, desktop and mobile software, to make capability and risk explicit and guide benchmarking.

title: A Trajectory-Based Safety Audit of Clawdbot (OpenClaw)
reason: Trajectory-based safety audit of the self-hosted Clawdbot (OpenClaw) personal agent spanning local execution and web workflows; an OS-level claw-style agent with no GUI operation stated.

title: World-Model-Augmented Web Agents with Action Correction
reason: Web agent that consults a world model to simulate action outcomes and correct risky actions, evaluated on VisualWebArena and Online-Mind2Web.

title: HiPER: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Explicit Credit Assignment for Large Language Model Agents
reason: Hierarchical plan-execute RL with hierarchical advantage estimation for LLM agents, evaluated on WebShop alongside ALFWorld.

title: IntentCUA: Learning Intent-level Representations for Skill Abstraction and Multi-Agent Planning in Computer-Use Agents
reason: Multi-agent computer-use framework with intent-aligned plan memory and reusable skills for long-horizon desktop automation across applications, outperforming RL and trajectory-retrieval baselines.

title: Web Agents Should Use Typed Actions Instead of Click-Based Browsing
reason: Position paper arguing that web agents should invoke typed web verbs instead of click, keystroke and DOM primitives; concerns the action interface of browser agents.

title: ProactiveMobile: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Boosting Proactive Intelligence on Mobile Devices
reason: Benchmarks proactive mobile agents that infer latent user intent from on-device context and output executable sequences from a pool of 63 APIs; a mobile-device setting, but actions are API calls rather than GUI operations.

title: GUI-Libra: Training Native GUI Agents to Reason and Act with Action-aware Supervision and Partially Verifiable RL
reason: Training recipe and 81K reasoning dataset for native GUI agents using action-aware SFT and KL-regularized RL, evaluated on web and mobile benchmarks.

title: Spatio-Temporal Token Pruning for Efficient High-Resolution GUI Agents
reason: Training-free spatio-temporal token pruning for high-resolution screenshot-based GUI agents that keeps the layout structure needed for coordinate grounding during GUI navigation.

title: CoME: Empowering Channel-of-Mobile-Experts with Informative Hybrid-Capabilities Reasoning
reason: Mobile GUI agent with stage-specific experts for screen summary, subtask planning and action decisions, trained progressively with information-gain DPO and tested on AITZ and AMEX.

title: ST-Lite: Training-Free KV Cache Compression with Spatio-Trajectory Guidance for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
reason: Training-free KV cache compression tailored to GUI interaction traces for VLM GUI agents, tested on seven GUI benchmarks.

title: M$^2$: Dual-Memory Augmentation for Long-Horizon Web Agents via Trajectory Summarization and Insight Retrieval
reason: Training-free dual memory (trajectory summarization plus retrieved insights) for long-horizon multimodal web navigation agents, evaluated on WebVoyager and Online-Mind2Web.

title: K^2-Agent: Co-Evolving Know-What and Know-How for Hierarchical Mobile Device Control
reason: Hierarchical mobile device-control agent that co-evolves declarative and procedural knowledge with curriculum GRPO, reaching 76.1% on AndroidWorld from raw screenshots and transferring to ScreenSpot-v2 and AitW.

title: PlugMem: A Task-Agnostic Plugin Memory Module for LLM Agents
reason: Task-agnostic knowledge-graph memory module for LLM agents, evaluated on conversational QA, multi-hop retrieval and web agent tasks, with web tasks as one of three settings.

title: STRUCTUREDAGENT: Planning with AND/OR Trees for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
reason: Hierarchical AND/OR-tree planning framework for LLM web agents on long-horizon tasks, evaluated on WebArena and multi-constraint shopping tasks.

title: Enhancing Web Agents with a Hierarchical Memory Tree
reason: Hierarchical Memory Tree separates intents, stages and actions mined from web trajectories to improve cross-website generalization of web agents on Mind2Web and WebArena.

title: Ares: Adaptive Reasoning Effort Selection for Efficient LLM Agents
reason: Per-step reasoning-effort router for LLM agents, evaluated on TAU-Bench, BrowseComp-Plus and WebArena.

title: SlowBA: An efficiency backdoor attack towards VLM-based GUI agents
reason: Backdoor attack that inflates reasoning length and response latency of VLM-based GUI agents, using pop-up windows as stealthy triggers.

title: Agentic Critical Training
reason: RLVR warm-up that trains agents to pick expert actions over sampled alternatives; WebShop is one material evaluation setting alongside ALFWorld and ScienceWorld.

title: AgentOS: From Application Silos to a Natural Language-Driven Data Ecosystem
reason: Position paper envisioning an agent operating system with a natural-language portal in place of GUI desktops for OpenClaw-style personal agents; OS-level agents rather than GUI operation.

title: Hybrid Self-evolving Structured Memory for GUI Agents
reason: Graph-based self-evolving hybrid memory that improves open-source VLM GUI agents on computer-use tasks.

title: You Told Me to Do It: Measuring Instructional Text-induced Private Data Leakage in LLM Agents
reason: Measures README-embedded instruction injection that makes high-privilege agents with terminal and filesystem access leak data, including a deployed computer-use agent; no GUI interaction is described.

title: AI Planning Framework for LLM-Based Web Agents
reason: Maps LLM web-agent architectures to classical planning paradigms, proposes trajectory-quality metrics, and releases 794 human-labeled WebArena trajectories.

title: Why Do LLM-based Web Agents Fail? A Hierarchical Planning Perspective
reason: Analyzes LLM web navigation agents through a hierarchical planning framework separating planning, execution and replanning, finding low-level grounding and execution to be the main failure source.

title: The Evolution of Tool Use in LLM Agents: From Single-Tool Call to Multi-Tool Orchestration
reason: Survey of multi-tool LLM agents that summarizes graphical user interfaces and mobile systems among its application areas.

title: IntentWeave: A Progressive Entry Ladder for Multi-Surface Browser Agents in Cloud Portals
reason: Designs and user-tests ways to embed an LLM browser agent across browser surfaces via an extension prototype on a cloud portal; interaction design for browser agents acting in web interfaces.

title: CAPTCHA Solving for Native GUI Agents: Automated Reasoning-Action Data Generation and Self-Corrective Training
reason: Trains a native GUI agent to solve interactive CAPTCHAs from screenshots using generated reasoning-action trajectories and self-correction data while keeping general GUI-benchmark performance.

title: Towards Automated Crowdsourced Testing via Personified-LLM
reason: Injects tester personas into LLM agents to automate crowdsourced GUI testing, producing more effective test events and finding crashes and bugs.

title: Vision2Web: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Visual Website Development with Agent Verification
reason: Benchmark for building websites from prototype images, from UI-to-code up to full-stack apps, checked by a GUI-agent verifier and a VLM judge; mainly UI code generation.

title: "What Did It Actually Do?": Understanding Risk Awareness and Traceability for Computer-Use Agents
reason: Interview study and traceability interface for users of OpenClaw-style personal agents that install skills and modify local environments; claw-style OS agents with no GUI operation described.

title: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation
reason: Argues terminal-only coding agents calling platform APIs can handle enterprise tasks, comparing them with MCP tool agents and GUI-based web agents.

title: When Users Change Their Mind: Evaluating Interruptible Agents in Long-Horizon Web Navigation
reason: Benchmark derived from WebArena-Lite that tests how web navigation agents adapt to mid-task user interruptions.

title: Read More, Think More: Revisiting Observation Reduction for Web Agents
reason: Revisits HTML versus accessibility-tree observations for LLM web agents, tying the better choice to model capability and thinking budget and proposing diff-based observation history.

title: AgentHazard: A Benchmark for Evaluating Harmful Behavior in Computer-Use Agents
reason: Harmful-behavior benchmark for computer-use agents run through CLI harnesses (Claude Code, OpenClaw, IFlow) acting on tools, files and execution environments, without GUI operation.

title: The Tool Illusion: Rethinking Tool Use in Web Agents
reason: Controlled large-scale study of whether higher-level tools help web agents beyond atomic browser actions, across tool sources, backbones, frameworks and web benchmarks.

title: Your Agent, Their Asset: A Real-World Safety Analysis of OpenClaw
reason: Real-world safety evaluation of the OpenClaw personal agent with local system, file and service access; claw-style agent security with no GUI interaction described.

title: MAESTRO: Adapting GUIs and Guiding Navigation with User Preferences in Conversational Agents with GUIs
reason: HCI system in which a conversational agent maps utterances to GUI actions, adapts in-app GUI elements to user preferences and guides backtracking in booking workflows, assessed in a user study rather than as an autonomous GUI agent.

title: VenusBench-Mobile: A Challenging and User-Centric Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents with Capability Diagnostics
reason: Online benchmark for mobile GUI agents with user-intent-driven tasks and capability-level annotations for diagnosing failures.

title: GameWorld: Towards Standardized and Verifiable Evaluation of Multimodal Game Agents
reason: GameWorld benchmarks multimodal game agents in browser games, including computer-use agents emitting keyboard and mouse input; game play through a generic computer interface.

title: Structured Distillation of Web Agent Capabilities Enables Generalization
reason: Synthesizes web agent trajectories with LLM annotator roles and fine-tunes a 9B web agent, evaluated on WebArena and WorkArena.

title: Same Outcomes, Different Journeys: A Trace-Level Framework for Comparing Human and GUI-Agent Behavior in Production Search Systems
reason: Trace-level framework comparing queries and interface navigation of a GUI agent and 39 people in a production audio-streaming search app.

title: Preference Redirection via Attention Concentration: An Attack on Computer Use Agents
reason: Adversarial-patch attack that redirects a computer-use agent's attention to steer product selection on an online shopping platform.

title: KnowU-Bench: Towards Interactive, Proactive, and Personalized Mobile Agent Evaluation
reason: Online benchmark for personalized and proactive mobile GUI agents in a reproducible Android emulator, with an LLM user simulator and grounded GUI execution.

title: Turing Test on Screen: A Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agent Humanization
reason: Benchmarks how detectable mobile GUI agents are from their touch dynamics, collects a human touch dataset, and proposes humanization methods that keep task performance.

title: MobiFlow: Real-World Mobile Agent Benchmarking through Trajectory Fusion
reason: Mobile GUI agent benchmark over 20 third-party apps that fuses multiple trajectories into state graphs for evaluation without system-level success APIs.

title: Agentic Compilation: Mitigating the LLM Rerun Crisis for Minimized-Inference-Cost Web Automation
reason: Web automation agent that compiles a sanitized DOM into a deterministic browser workflow once, cutting inference cost for repeated form filling and data extraction.

title: The Blind Spot of Agent Safety: How Benign User Instructions Expose Critical Vulnerabilities in Computer-Use Agents
reason: Benchmarks whether computer-use agents cause harm when user instructions are benign, with threats embedded in the environment across eight applications.

title: CocoaBench: Evaluating Unified Digital Agents in the Wild
reason: Benchmark for unified digital agents whose tasks combine vision, search and coding; GUI automation is named as an integrated capability and visual grounding as a weakness, but GUI operation is not detailed.

title: Mobile GUI Agent Privacy Personalization with Trajectory Induced Preference Optimization
reason: Preference optimization that personalizes mobile GUI agents' privacy behavior across structurally different trajectories, with a privacy preference dataset.

title: From Imitation to Discrimination: Progressive Curriculum Learning for Robust Web Navigation
reason: Hard-negative HTML dataset and SFT-ORPO-GRPO curriculum for text-based web navigation agents, evaluated on Mind2Web.

title: Towards Scalable Lightweight GUI Agents via Multi-role Orchestration
reason: Trains a lightweight 3B native GUI agent with role-oriented data, SFT and RL so it can act alone or as an executor under planners in multi-role GUI automation.

title: RiskWebWorld: A Realistic Interactive Benchmark for GUI Agents in E-commerce Risk Management
reason: Interactive benchmark of 1,513 e-commerce risk-management tasks for GUI agents on realistic websites, with Gymnasium infrastructure used for agentic RL.

title: SkillDroid: Compile Once, Reuse Forever
reason: Compiles successful LLM-guided mobile GUI trajectories into parameterized skills that replay without LLM calls, with recompilation when reliability drops.

title: Zoom Consistency: A Free Confidence Signal in Multi-Step Visual Grounding Pipelines
reason: Uses the agreement between zoom-in steps as a free confidence signal for VLM GUI grounding across operating systems and uses it to route between specialist and generalist grounders.

title: StressWeb: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Web Agent Robustness under Realistic Interaction Variability
reason: Stress-testing benchmark that perturbs layouts, interaction semantics and execution in controlled web environments to diagnose multimodal web agent robustness.

title: Mango: Multi-Agent Web Navigation via Global-View Optimization
reason: Multi-agent web navigation method that picks start URLs with Thompson sampling and keeps episodic memory, evaluated on WebVoyager and WebWalkerQA.

title: Human-Guided Harm Recovery for Computer Use Agents
reason: Harm recovery for computer-use agents via a preference-trained reward model, plus BackBench, 50 computer-use tasks for recovering from harmful states.

title: AutomationBench
reason: Benchmark of cross-application business workflow automation via REST APIs (CRM, inbox, calendar); application automation through APIs, with no GUI.

title: AgentLens: Adaptive Visual Modalities for Human-Agent Interaction in Mobile GUI Agents
reason: AgentLens is a mobile GUI agent that adaptively shows full, partial or generated UI to users during background execution, evaluated in a 21-participant user study.

title: SOLAR-RL: Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning
reason: Semi-online RL that reconstructs rollouts from static data and assigns dense step rewards to train MLLM GUI agents for long-horizon GUI navigation.

title: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
reason: Survey of agentic world models with a levels-by-laws taxonomy whose digital regime explicitly covers web and GUI agents alongside physical, social and scientific settings.

title: PageGuide: Browser extension to assist users in navigating a webpage and locating information
reason: Browser extension that grounds LLM answers in page DOM elements and guides users across pages with step evidence; a human-assistive web navigation tool tested in a user study rather than an autonomous web agent.

title: GUI Agents with Reinforcement Learning: Toward Digital Inhabitants
reason: Survey of reinforcement learning for GUI agents, with a taxonomy of offline, online and hybrid RL plus reward design and world-model training.

title: FineState-Bench: Benchmarking State-Conditioned Grounding for Fine-grained GUI State Setting
reason: Benchmark of state-conditioned GUI grounding across desktop, web and mobile with stage-wise metrics and a visual diagnostic assistant.

title: AEM: Adaptive Entropy Modulation for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
reason: Supervision-free entropy-based credit assignment for multi-turn agentic RL, evaluated on ALFWorld, WebShop and SWE-bench Verified; web shopping is one of several evaluation settings.

title: Learn where to Click from Yourself: On-Policy Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding
reason: On-policy self-distillation for GUI grounding with a privileged teacher context and entropy-guided token weighting, evaluated on six GUI grounding benchmarks.

title: Planner Matters! An Efficient and Unbalanced Multi-agent Collaboration Framework for Long-horizon Planning
reason: Planner-centric RL for a planner, actor and memory multi-agent framework, evaluated on web navigation and OS control benchmarks alongside tool use.

title: AcademiClaw: When Students Set Challenges for AI Agents
reason: Benchmarks OpenClaw-style agents on long-horizon academic tasks run in Docker sandboxes; an evaluation of claw-style personal agents with no GUI interaction described.

title: Augmenting Interface Usability Heuristics for Reliable Computer-Use Agents
reason: Revisits usability heuristics for computer-use agents and tests augmented interface designs in the controlled UI-Verse environments.

title: cotomi Act: Learning to Automate Work by Watching You
reason: Browser computer-use agent that turns observed user browsing into shared organizational knowledge and exceeds the reported human baseline on a WebArena subset.

title: Constraining Host-Level Abuse in Self-Hosted Computer-Use Agents via TEE-Backed Isolation
reason: Security design that confines host-level operations of self-hosted claw-style computer-use agents such as OpenClaw; it targets commands and host resources rather than GUI interaction.

title: BAMI: Training-Free Bias Mitigation in GUI Grounding
reason: Training-free coarse-to-fine focus and candidate selection that reduce precision and ambiguity biases in GUI grounding models, improving ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy.

title: Securing Computer-Use Agents: A Unified Architecture-Lifecycle Framework for Deployment-Grounded Reliability
reason: Review-style architecture-lifecycle framework for reliability and security of computer-use agents that operate browsers, desktops, mobile apps and terminals, synthesizing systems, benchmarks and security studies.

title: LiteGUI: Lightweight GUI Agents via Multi-Solution Guided Distillation and Dual-Level Reinforcement Learning
reason: Lightweight GUI agents post-trained with guided on-policy distillation and multi-solution GRPO on logged GUI states, with a new multi-solution GUI dataset.

title: Computer Use at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
reason: Exposes flaws in computer-use agent evaluation and proposes environment design principles, a sandboxed mobile-app benchmark (DigiWorld) and hierarchical confidence-interval aggregation.

title: WebTrap: Stealthy Mid-Task Hijacking of Browser Agents During Navigation
reason: Mid-task hijacking prompt-injection attack on browser agents during navigation, evaluated in extended WASP and InjecAgent environments.

title: OTora: A Unified Red Teaming Framework for Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service in LLM Agents
reason: Red-teams LLM agents with reasoning-level denial-of-service attacks that inflate reasoning and tool calls, evaluated on WebShop, email and OS agents among its settings.

title: WildClawBench: A Benchmark for Real-World, Long-Horizon Agent Evaluation
reason: Native-runtime benchmark running CLI agent harnesses (OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes) on long-horizon tasks with real tools in Docker; terminal and claw-style computer work without a GUI.

title: ProjGuard: Safety Monitoring for Computer-Use Agents via Low-Dimensional Projections
reason: Runtime safety monitor for computer-use agents that projects response history to a risk score and triggers VLM intervention, evaluated on OS-Harm and RiosWorld.

title: SimPersona: Learning Discrete Buyer Personas from Raw Clickstreams for Grounded E-Commerce Agents
reason: Learns discrete buyer personas from clickstreams to condition LLM web agents that navigate live storefronts, fine-tuned on real browsing traces.

title: Beyond Binary: Reframing GUI Critique as Continuous Semantic Alignment
reason: Contrastively trained GUI critic for ranking candidate GUI agent actions at test time, with a hierarchical GUI critic benchmark.

title: Video2GUI: Synthesizing Large-Scale Interaction Trajectories for Generalized GUI Agent Pretraining
reason: Pipeline that mines GUI tutorial videos into 12M grounded interaction trajectories (WildGUI) for GUI agent pretraining, improving GUI grounding and action benchmarks.

title: Known By Their Actions: Fingerprinting LLM Browser Agents via UI Traces
reason: Shows that websites can passively identify the LLM behind a browser agent from its UI action and timing traces, a security risk for web agents.

title: WARD: Adversarially Robust Defense of Web Agents Against Prompt Injections
reason: WARD is a guard model trained on large web data with adversarial co-evolution to defend web agents against HTML and visual prompt injection.

title: Orchard: An Open-Source Agentic Modeling Framework
reason: Open agentic modeling framework whose recipes include a 4B computer-use agent evaluated on WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web and DeepShop, alongside SWE and personal-assistant agents.

title: PersonaFingerprint: Measuring Persona Inference on Modern Websites with LLM-Driven Browsing
reason: Uses a persona-constrained computer-use agent browsing real websites to collect encrypted traffic for a website-fingerprinting privacy study; the agent serves as browsing infrastructure.

title: PAGER: Bridging the Semantic-Execution Gap in Point-Precise Geometric GUI Control
reason: Benchmark and topology-aware agent for point-precise GUI actions on geometric construction canvases, trained with pixel-grounded SFT and precision-aligned RL.

title: ScreenSearch: Uncertainty-Aware OS Exploration
reason: Large-scale desktop GUI exploration that indexes UIA-tree screens, deduplicates states into a shared graph and guides search with an ambiguity-aware PUCT bandit over 11 desktop apps.

title: ShopGym: An Integrated Framework for Realistic Simulation and Scalable Benchmarking of E-Commerce Web Agents
reason: Framework that converts live storefronts into sandbox shops and synthesizes grounded tasks for benchmarking e-commerce web agents.

title: Skim: Speculative Execution for Fast and Efficient Web Agents
reason: Speculative execution for web agents that profiles site URL patterns to skip browser rendering and planning, tested with WebVoyager, AgentOccam and BrowserUse agents.

title: TriAxialKV: Toward Extreme Low-Precision KV-Cache Quantization for Agentic Inference Tasks
reason: Mixed-precision KV-cache quantization tagged by recency, modality and role for agentic inference, evaluated with a VLM computer-use agent on OSWorld.

title: DiagEval: Trajectory-Conditioned Diagnosis for Reliable Software Evaluation with GUI Agents
reason: Proposes a diagnostic protocol that reuses failed GUI-agent trajectories to tell evaluator errors from real defects when GUI agents test LLM-generated interactive software.

title: AQuaUI: Visual Token Reduction for GUI Agents with Adaptive Quadtrees
reason: Training-free adaptive-quadtree token reduction for GUI agent models on screenshots, evaluated on GUI grounding and navigation benchmarks.

title: What and When to Distill: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
reason: General RL framework that uses selective environment feedback for multi-turn LLM agents, evaluated on WebShop and ALFWorld.

title: CutVerse: A Compositional GUI Agents Benchmark for Media Post-Production Editing
reason: CutVerse benchmarks GUI agents on 186 long-horizon editing tasks in professional apps such as Premiere Pro and Photoshop, with a parser for screen recordings.

title: MemGym: a Long-Horizon Memory Environment for LLM Agents
reason: Agent memory benchmark spanning tool-use dialogue, deep research, coding and a computer-use track on WebArena-Infinity, so web interaction is one material setting among several.

title: Spreadsheet-RL: Advancing Large Language Model Agents on Realistic Spreadsheet Tasks via Reinforcement Learning
reason: Trains spreadsheet agents with RL in an Excel environment exposed through a Python sandbox and tool set; office application automation via APIs rather than GUI control.

title: DRIVE: Modeling Skills at the Reasoning and Interaction Levels for Web Agents under Continual Learning
reason: Proposes dual-level reasoning and page-interaction skills for web agents under continual learning, evaluated on five WebArena domains.

title: AgentHijack: Benchmarking Computer Use Agent Robustness to Common Environment Corruptions
reason: Benchmarks computer-use agent robustness to common desktop corruptions such as pop-ups and resolution changes, and proposes a grounding-enhanced agent with an environment-checking onlooker.

title: Anchor: Preventing Artifact Drift for Reliable Agent Verification
reason: Builds ERP-Bench, 300 long-horizon procurement and manufacturing tasks in a production ERP system with solver-certified state verifiers, used to evaluate browser and computer-use agents alongside coding agents.

title: ChartAct: A Benchmark for Dynamic Chart Understanding
reason: Interactive benchmark in which multimodal models and GUI agents must hover, click, zoom or drag on web charts and dashboards to answer questions.

title: Scaling, Benchmarking, and Reasoning of Vision-Language Agents for Mobile GUI Navigation
reason: Large mobile GUI navigation dataset over 650+ Chinese apps plus an offline benchmarking toolkit for VLM agents, with analysis of SFT versus RL data scaling.

title: Mobile-Aptus: Confidence-Driven Proactive and Robust Interaction in MLLM-based Mobile-Using Agents
reason: Trains MLLM mobile GUI agents to output calibrated confidence so they ask for help only when needed, evaluated on AITZ, Meta-GUI, AndroidControl and OS-Kairos plus real-device runs.

title: Learn from Weaknesses: Automated Domain Specialization for Small Computer-Use Agents
reason: Weakness-targeted task synthesis and error-aware training to specialize small computer-use agents per software domain, with gains on OSWorld.

title: PRO-CUA: Process-Reward Optimization for Computer Use Agents
reason: Step-level process-reward RL for computer-use agents trained on their own live rollouts and evaluated on live web benchmarks.

title: GTA: Generating Long-Horizon Tasks for Web Agents at Scale
reason: Scalable pipeline that crawls 50+ websites to generate multi-hop web-agent tasks with executable, replayable trajectories, released as a dynamic web agent benchmark.

title: STAMP: Training Explicit Memory for Mobile GUI Agents in Controllable and Scalable Virtual Environments
reason: Synthesizes tasks with injected memory variables in virtual phone environments to teach mobile GUI agents what to remember, using SFT and online RL, and adds a Memory-World benchmark.

title: Revisiting Observation Reduction for Web Agents: Comprehensive Evaluation with a Lightweight Framework
reason: Evaluates HTML observation reduction for LLM web agents with a minimal-failure-set proxy metric and optimizes pruning on WorkArena and WebLinx.

title: Recovering Policy-Induced Errors: Benchmarking and Trajectory Synthesis for Robust GUI Agents
reason: Introduces GUI-RobustEval for error recovery and an 800k-sample recovery trajectory synthesis pipeline; fine-tuned GUI agents reach 47.4% on OSWorld.

title: DiffSpot: Can VLMs Spot Fine-Grained Visual Differences in Web Interfaces?
reason: Benchmark testing whether VLMs detect fine-grained CSS-induced visual differences in rendered web interfaces, motivated by GUI agents and design tools.

title: Does The Way You Plan Matter? An Empirical Study of Planning Representations for LLM Web Agents
reason: Planner-executor study comparing four plan representations for multimodal LLM web agents on hard WebArena tasks, with new success-rate decomposition metrics.

title: GUI-C$^2$: Coarse-to-Fine GUI Grounding via Difficulty-Aware Reinforcement Learning
reason: Improves GUI grounding with difficulty-scored training samples and an RL-trained, area-gated coarse-to-fine cropping strategy for locating screen elements.

title: BlueFin: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Financial Spreadsheets
reason: Benchmarks LLM agents on professional finance spreadsheet workbook tasks with a validated LM judge; spreadsheet application automation, with no GUI operation stated.

title: Learning to Adapt: Self-Improving Web Agent via Cognitive-Aware Exploration
reason: Self-improving multimodal web agent via adversarial exploration roles and graph exploration, with a 20K-task dataset from 19 real websites.

title: Masking Stale Observations Helps Search Agents -- Until It Doesn't: A Regime Map and Its Mechanism
reason: Studies masking stale observations for deep search agents on offline and live-web benchmarks where agents open pages; a browsing research-agent setting.

title: "I Strongly Suspect This Website Is a Scam": Benchmarking PII Leakage and Detection without Defense in Autonomous Web Agents
reason: Benchmark of attacker-controlled scam websites that lure autonomous web agents into submitting users' PII; privacy and security of web agents.

title: BraveGuard: From Open-World Threats to Safer Computer-Use Agents
reason: Trains guard models for computer-use agents from mined threats turned into executable computer-use tasks, improving trajectory-level safety detection.

title: OpenWebRL: Demystifying Online Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning for Visual Web Agents
reason: Open framework for online multi-turn RL of visual web agents on live websites, with live-browser infrastructure, evaluated on Online-Mind2Web and DeepShop.

title: Context-Aware Workflow Decomposition for Automated Mobile UI Annotation Using Multimodal Large Language Models
reason: Studies staged MLLM prompting workflows for annotating mobile UI elements on MUIAnno screens, aimed at UI understanding datasets and GUI agent development.

title: Perceive Before Reasoning: A Pre-Reasoning Perception Framework for Efficient and Reliable Proactive Mobile Agents
