reason: Two-stage perceive-then-reason framework for MLLM-based proactive mobile agents that first decide whether to intervene, evaluated on the ProactiveMobile benchmark.

title: Demo2Tutorial: From Human Experience to Multimodal Software Tutorials
reason: Turns screen recordings and interaction logs into multimodal software tutorials and shows that they improve GUI-agent planning and generalization.

title: MIRAGE: Mobile Agents with Implicit Reasoning and Generative World Models
reason: MIRAGE gives mobile GUI agents latent reasoning aligned with predicted future screenshots, evaluated on AndroidWorld and AndroidControl.

title: AppAgent-Claw: CLI Is All You Need for GUI Automation
reason: Turns demonstrated GUI workflows into replayable OpenClaw skills, using layered visual localization and on-screen effect validation so an agent can automate GUI-only tasks.

title: PerceptUI: LLM Agents as Human-Aligned Synthetic Users for UI/UX Evaluation
reason: Trains persona-conditioned multimodal LLMs to predict how specific users would judge interfaces, acting as synthetic participants for UI/UX evaluation rather than operating the UI.

title: Self-evolving LLM agents with in-distribution Optimization
reason: Self-evolving RL with in-distribution critics and process rewards for LLM agents, evaluated on WebShop with ALFWorld and ScienceWorld.

title: MemVenom: Triggered Poisoning of Multimodal Memories in Web Agents
reason: Black-box attack that plants coordinated text-image content in web agents' multimodal memory and uses OCR injection to override user goals, tested across several web-agent frameworks.

title: Reasoning for Mobile User Experience with Multimodal LLMs: Task, Benchmark, and Approach
reason: UXBench for diagnosing UX problems in real UI screenshots plus an RL-tuned MLLM for it; UI critique from screenshots rather than agents operating interfaces.

title: Benchmarking Web Agent Safety under E-commerce Deceptive Interfaces
reason: Injects deceptive e-commerce UI patterns such as targeted ads and redirects into web environments and measures how often multimodal web agents are manipulated.

title: A Benchmark and Framework for Evaluating Next Action Predictions in Spreadsheets
reason: Benchmark of curated spreadsheet user-action sequences with online evaluation of next-action prediction; spreadsheet application automation rather than an agent operating a GUI.

title: Running the Gauntlet: Hard Agentic Tasks
reason: Web-based benchmark of vision-intensive tasks in five professional web applications (video editor, workflow builder, 3D modeller, flight analyser, circuit designer) for evaluating GUI agents.

title: Where Did It Go Wrong? Process-Level Evaluation of Web Agents with Semantic State Tracking
reason: Web agent benchmark that tracks semantic states behind the GUI for process-level analysis of computer-use agents' exploration and errors.

title: LLM-as-Code: Agentic Programming for Agent Harness
reason: Proposes program-controlled agent loops that invoke the LLM only as a component; its evaluation is a computer-use agent case study showing more stable long visual operation sequences.

title: Beyond Domains: Reusing Web Skills via Transferable Interaction Patterns
reason: Web agent that induces reusable web skills and transfers them across sites by layout similarity, cutting action counts on WebArena and Mind2Web.

title: OctoNest: Adaptive Cross-Device Execution through Stateful Control
reason: Cross-device computer-use agent system that coordinates per-device agents and switches interaction modality on failure, with a new cross-device benchmark (CAPEBench).

title: SkillHarness: Harnessing Safe Skills for Computer-Use Agents
reason: Framework for safe skill learning and reuse by computer-use agents facing prompt injections and pop-up disruptions.

title: When Web Agents Finish but Still Fail: Reproducible Triggers and Trace Diagnostics for Parallel Web Exploration
reason: Parallel web-exploration benchmark with verified URL trajectories and GRPO-trained WebExplorer-style agents that visit pages to gather information.

title: Agent MechSuits: Mechanistic Subspace Safety Steering for Multi-Turn CLI Agents
reason: White-box safety detection and steering for multi-turn CLI agents with an annotated trajectory benchmark; terminal-based computer operation without a GUI.

title: When AUC 0.998 Is Not Enough: A Candidate Evaluation Protocol for Hidden-State Probes of Indirect Prompt Injection in Multimodal Computer-Use Agents
reason: Examines hidden-state probes that flag indirect prompt injection in a multimodal computer-use agent on Mind2Web and proposes diagnostic controls; safety evaluation for web/computer-use agents.

title: AOHP: An Open-Source OS-Level Agent Harness for Personalized, Efficient and Secure Interaction
reason: Builds an AOSP-based Android harness that treats agents as OS actors with adaptive UIs and agent interfaces, and evaluates mobile OS-agent task completion, token cost and security compliance.

title: Ko-WideSearch: A Korean Breadth-Search Benchmark for Exhaustive Set Enumeration by Web Agents
reason: Korean breadth-search benchmark in which web agents must enumerate complete sets and fill attribute tables, evaluating twenty web agents; an information-seeking browsing benchmark.

title: Bridging VideoQA and Video-Guided Agentic Tasks via Generalized Keyframe Extraction
reason: Introduces VG-GUIBench for GUI agents that must follow video tutorials, plus a keyframe extraction method evaluated on it and on VideoQA.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2: Evaluating Agents on End-to-End Business Spreadsheet Workflows
reason: Workflow-level benchmark for spreadsheet agents on large business workbooks under a multi-turn scaffold; spreadsheet automation without stated GUI operation.

title: PPT-Eval: A Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents on PowerPoint Tasks
reason: Benchmarks computer-use agents on PowerPoint creation and editing tasks with rubric-based partial-credit evaluation.

title: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States
reason: Active execution-state memory and selective-use RL for mobile GUI agents on long cross-app tasks, with a new mobile benchmark and scope-aware metrics.

title: BaRA: Budget-constrained and Reliable Web Data Collection Agent
reason: LLM web agent that discovers site pages by link search and extracts multimodal artifacts from live websites under a budget; closer to agentic crawling than interactive page operation.

title: A Task-State Representation for Long-Horizon Mobile GUI Agents
reason: Training-free wrapper that tracks task state separately from screen observations for long-horizon mobile GUI agents, tested on four mobile GUI benchmarks.

title: TurnOPD: Making On-Policy Distillation Turn-Aware for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Training
reason: Turn-aware on-policy distillation for long-horizon language agents, evaluated on ALFWorld, WebShop and multi-hop search, so the WebShop web environment is one setting among several.

title: Prismata: Confining Cross-Site Prompt Injection in Web Agents
reason: Prismata defends autonomous web agents against cross-site prompt injection by deriving trust labels for page content and limiting what the agent sees and can do.

title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
reason: Benchmark for claw-style proactive agents on real-world tasks in live Docker containers; the abstract shows OS-level tool use but does not describe GUI interaction.

title: Designing Agent-Ready Websites for AI Web Agents: A Framework for Machine Readability, Actionability, and Decision Reliability
reason: Proposes an agent-ready e-commerce website design framework and tests it with three browser-agent models over 300 runs, comparing task success and step counts against a human-oriented site.

title: PalmClaw: A Native On-Device Agent Framework for Mobile Phones
reason: On-device phone agent framework that exposes device capabilities as explicit tools instead of GUI taps and swipes; a claw-style mobile agent rather than GUI operation.

title: Multi-Head Latent Control: A Unified Interface for LLM Agent Decision Making
reason: Reads hidden states of frozen LLMs and VLMs to decide deferral, tool use or abstention; routed execution is evaluated on AndroidWorld among other language and vision benchmarks.

title: Just A Rather Very Intelligent Spoken Agent
reason: Benchmark for a spoken mediator between users and long-horizon worker agents, run on text-only WildClaw tasks in OpenClaw; claw-style agent workflows without GUI operation.

title: Teach it to stop, not just to click
reason: Variance-aware study of verifier-guided repair for a 35B computer-use agent across GUI environments, covering click grounding, form filling and done detection, with a k-seed reporting library.

title: DocOps: A Verifiable Benchmark for Autonomous Agents in Complex Document Operations
reason: DocOps benchmarks agents on verifiable document manipulation workflows across harnesses; office document automation, with the interaction interface left unspecified.

title: PersonaTrail: Benchmarking Personalized Web Agents through Browsing Trails
reason: Benchmark for personalized web agents that infer preferences from browsing trails in a managed open web environment, plus a structured memory method for navigation.

title: StepX-Edge: An On-Device UI Vision-Language Model via Architecture-Training-Deployment Co-Design
reason: Presents a 0.9B on-device UI vision-language model for screen understanding, OCR and element grounding, evaluated on ScreenQA and deployed on mobile chips with quantization.

title: SafeFlow: Semantic Information-Flow Control for Blocking Malicious Propagation in Multi-Agent Systems
reason: Semantic information-flow defense for multi-agent systems, evaluated on four safety benchmarks, one of which covers harmful web-agent behavior alongside prompt injection, unsafe tool use and code execution.

title: OmegaUse-OfficeVal: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Office-Suite Tasks with Economic Grounding
reason: Benchmark of LLM agents on long-horizon office-suite tasks with labor-time and price signals; office application work, though the abstract does not say whether agents use GUIs or scripts.

title: IndustryForge-27B: A Domain-Enhanced Multimodal Foundation Model for Industrial CAD
reason: CAD-domain multimodal model that reads drawings and geometry screenshots and writes Windows COM API code for Inventor and SolidWorks, i.e. application automation through scripts rather than GUI actions.

title: MemHarness: Memory Is Reconstructed, Not Replayed
reason: Trains LLM agents with GRPO to critique and reconstruct retrieved experiences, evaluated on WebShop alongside ALFWorld.

title: Alignment Is Local: A Paired Diagnostic for GUI Agents under User-Side Persuasion
reason: Paired diagnostic of GUI and mobile agents under screen-grounded user-side persuasion, measuring how a prompt guardrail erodes over multi-turn escalation.

title: RMSWeb: Reflection, Failure-Mode Mining, and Salvage-DS for Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
reason: RL recipe with reflection retries, failure-mode mining and dynamic sampling for compact web agents on WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web and WebTailBench.

title: LongHorizon-Harness: Advancing Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Tasks
reason: General long-horizon agent harness with explicit task state and auditing, evaluated on WeaveBench, Terminal-Bench and OSWorld 2.0; computer use is one material evaluation setting among others.

title: Invisible Ink Threats: Adversarial Goals Behind Legitimate Tasks in Computer-Use Agents
reason: Benchmark and VM-plus-web testing framework for low-harm indirect prompt injections against computer-use agents under human-in-the-loop confirmation.

title: FocusMem: Factorizing Content, Readout, and Trust in Latent GUI Memory
reason: Factorized latent memory with role-aware content, state-conditioned readout and a trust gate for frozen GUI agent policies, outperforming fixed-memory baselines on five GUI-agent benchmarks.

title: Activity Frames: Deterministic Screen-Activity Compilation for Agent Memory and Replay
reason: Deterministically compiles passively captured screen activity into typed frames that serve as computer-use agent memory and support routine replay.

title: WebGrader: Training LLMs for Web Development with Self-Evolving Programmatic Grader
reason: RL for website generation with a grader that derives interaction flows, executes them in a live browser against the DOM and rewards observed state changes; web code generation with browser-based testing.

title: StepJack: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agent Safety Against Multi-Step Indirect Prompt Injection
reason: Benchmark of multi-step indirect prompt injection spread across web pages along a computer-use agent's navigation path, evaluating six CUAs.

title: WebRider: Persona-Conditioned Intent Controllers for Live-Web Assistance
reason: Live-web agent that executes guarded browser actions under intent contracts, with a benchmark over 42 public websites and a trained action-policy model.

title: MemPrism: Task-Conditioned Relational Memory Views for Long-Horizon Agents
reason: Task-conditioned relational memory views designed for reusing earlier page observations in long-horizon web tasks, evaluated on web-agent and embodied benchmarks.

title: SynChain: Inducing Computer-Use Agent Systems to Construct Their Own Attack Chains
reason: Poisoning attack that persists in self-made skills and memory of agents framed as computer-use, tested on OpenClaw, Codex and Claude Code; terminal-style agents with no GUI described.

title: Back to the Future: A workbook time machine for spread sheet creation benchmarks
reason: Pipeline producing spreadsheet-creation benchmarks (formulas, charts, pivot tables, formatting) that evaluates spreadsheet agents and the control APIs they use; office application automation.

title: Software Engineering for and with GUI Agent
reason: Systematic review of 336 GUI-agent papers from a software-engineering perspective, covering architectures, evaluation and lifecycle concerns.

title: SkillLens: Visual Skill Cards for Retrieval-Augmented GUI Action Prediction and On-Policy Distillation
reason: Encodes illustrated GUI procedures as visual skill cards for retrieval-augmented action prediction and on-policy distillation, evaluated on web tasks from ten unseen websites.

title: Test-Time Self-Evolving GUI Visual Grounding via Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
reason: Test-time self-evolving GUI visual grounding that explores unseen interfaces, reflects with an MLLM judge and distills the reflections on-policy.

title: CoAdapt-GUI: Joint Workflow Context and Policy Adaptation for Unseen GUI Applications
reason: Test-time adaptation of workflow context and policy for mobile GUI agents on unseen apps, evaluated on AndroidWorld variants.

title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
reason: Stateful agent runtime with runbooks that raises Terminal-Bench 2.1 scores; terminal agents with no GUI involved.

title: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements
reason: General evolution-strategies fine-tuning for long-horizon LLM agents, evaluated on WebArena-Lite web tasks plus an automatic heuristic design setting.

title: Towards Faithful Simulation of Human Shopping Behavior
reason: GUI-grounded shopping simulation agent that perceives e-commerce pages through screenshots, trained with trajectory-level RL, plus an interactive e-commerce GUI trajectory dataset.

title: Automated Trajectory Evaluation for Mobile Agents via Step-Level Consequence Reasoning and Aggregation
reason: Step-level VLM-as-judge framework for evaluating mobile agent trajectories and operational safety, tested on AndroidWorld and MobileRisk.

title: Spine-Branch Coordination for Multi-agent Computer Use
reason: Coordinates multi-agent computer-use agents across parallel VMs with a spine-branch task graph that avoids merging VM state, evaluated on long-horizon Odysseys tasks with three CUA backbones.

title: ClawProBench: Trace-Aware Evaluation of AI Agents with Runtime Coverage and Frozen Workplace-Style Holdouts
reason: Trace-aware benchmark for agents on the OpenClaw runtime, whose workspace tools and native surfaces include browsing, messaging and scheduling; an OS-level claw-style agent setting rather than GUI operation.

title: MCP-Driven Accessibility Tree Standardization for AI-Powered Screen Reader Agents
reason: Conceptual MCP layer that exposes cross-platform accessibility trees to LLM assistive agents interacting with GUIs, compared against screenshot-based perception.

title: GameWAM: A World Action Model for Video Games
reason: World-action model that generates keyboard-mouse actions and future frames for native video-game play, with a GUI-control mode trained on synchronized gameplay and GUI trajectories.

title: Benchmarking General Mobile Assistants in Challenging Real-World Scenarios
reason: Benchmark of 300 mobile assistant tasks over seven open-source apps, with ablations of agent harness design for mobile GUI agents.

title: CA-OPD: Confidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Structured Visual Prediction
reason: General on-policy distillation method for structured visual prediction, evaluated on GUI grounding benchmarks such as ScreenSpot-Pro alongside OCR benchmarks.

title: Tail-Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
reason: General tail-likelihood RL objective evaluated on several tasks, one of which is GUI grounding, alongside object localization, maze navigation and code optimization.

title: Beyond the Verdict: Evidence-Aligned Evaluation of Visual Prompt-Injection Guardrails
reason: Introduces Mind2Web-Injection, a screenshot benchmark with evidence boxes for checking whether VLM guardrails of web agents detect and localize visual prompt injections.

title: OmniStepBench: Deployment-Aware Agent Evaluation across Modalities and Task Complexity
reason: Deployment-aware benchmark of 233 multimodal, multi-step agent tasks run in a shared OpenClaw execution environment; an OS-level claw-style agent setting rather than GUI operation.

title: FinCUABuild: Can Agents Build Reliable Benchmarks for Dynamic Financial Computer Use?
reason: Benchmark and multi-agent builder for automatically constructing dynamic financial computer-use agent tasks, environments and validators, checked for how well they separate CUA abilities.

title: VRL-Bench: Benchmarking agents on computer control tasks under finite trial budgets
reason: Provides a harness for evaluating verbal trial-and-error learning under finite trial budgets on MiniWoB and WebShop computer-control tasks, and proposes the VEX² exploration-exploitation scheduler.

title: CoArena: Evaluating Computer-Use and Multi-Agent Systems in Real Time
reason: Real-time arena where systems run user-submitted tasks in sandboxed desktops and are rated from blind pairwise judgments, an evaluation method for computer-use agents.

title: RSIAgent: Autonomous Exploration for Recursive Self-improvement in New Environments
reason: Training-free self-exploration and memory-building framework for digital agents facing unfamiliar interfaces, evaluated mainly on the OSWorld-v2 computer-use benchmark plus Agent's Last Exam.

title: RiskChainBench: A Benchmark for Obfuscated Platform Message Restoration and Evidence-Grounded Web Investigation
reason: Benchmark where a model restores obfuscated platform messages and then acts as a VLM-driven web agent investigating the linked risky website inside resettable local web environments.

title: The Verifiable Action Card: Trustworthy Human-in-the-Loop Control for Secure Autonomous Agents
reason: Out-of-band verifiable approval cards for agentic browsers that bind confirmations to the actual pending browser action, blocking prompt injection and forged dialogs on a 24-scenario benchmark.

title: Affora: A Design System for Agent-Friendly Interfaces
reason: Design system and executable checks that make interfaces legible to computer-use agents, with controlled studies of how component and visual variations affect agent performance.

title: Seeing Through Conflicts: Improving Instruction Hierarchy Alignment in Vision-Language Models
reason: RL training for multimodal instruction-hierarchy alignment in VLMs, with gains shown on web-agent safety tasks among other evaluations.

title: MATE: Policy-Aware Security Auditing for Mobile Agents via Synthesis-Driven Trajectory Learning
reason: Policy-conditioned auditor that checks mobile GUI agent trajectories against natural-language security policies, with synthesized trajectories, a benchmark and audits of real-device agents.

title: SPECTRA: On-Device Cognitive Perturbation and Trajectory Analysis for Autonomous Edge-Cloud GUI Grounding
reason: Decides when an on-device GUI grounding model should offload to a cloud model using perturbation-based confidence estimation, tested with pairs of GUI grounding models.

title: SimTrace: Grounded Multimodal User Trajectories Generation for Online User Modeling
reason: Generates synthetic multimodal web clickstreams with a computer-use client agent acting in a simulated twin of a web environment, pairing each action with web observations.

title: StateFork: Branchable Infrastructure for Agent Exploration
reason: Branching and checkpoint-restore infrastructure for terminal-using agents whose actions change files, processes and local services, evaluated on Terminal-Bench.

title: GraphForge: Training Working Agents with Graph-Anchored Workspace Synthesis
reason: Synthesizes real-file workspace tasks with evidence-anchored rubrics to train working agents, evaluated under OpenHands and Claude Code on GDPVal and spreadsheet benchmarks; file and CLI work, no GUI.

title: ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation
reason: Mitigates collapse in iterative agent self-distillation on ALFWorld and TextCraft, with an added action-prediction test for multimodal GUI agents on AITZ.

title: HyperBrowseComp: A Multilingual and Multimodal Stress Test for Web-Browsing Agents
reason: Multilingual, multimodal BrowseComp-style benchmark for web-browsing agents that must find obscure evidence across open-web pages, videos, scans and maps.

title: PlaySuite: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Interactive Visual Intelligence
reason: Benchmarks VLMs, computer-use agents and VLA models on over 5K open-source video games through a unified closed-loop interaction framework; game playing rather than app, web or desktop tasks.

title: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
reason: Open-source personal agent that acts on a person's phone and computer screens across devices, with an action-checking Sentinel and readable file memory.

title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
reason: Studies when to evolve an agent harness versus train weights by reading failure composition, mainly on DeepPlanning, with a transfer experiment on WebArena-Lite web tasks as a secondary setting.

title: A Decade in a Day: Synthesizing Agent-Native Interfaces from Human-Oriented Software Evolution
reason: Benchmarks LLM agents on 255 verified tasks across releases of six desktop applications to find interface properties that help agents, then synthesizes agent-native interfaces that raise desktop task success.

title: EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications
reason: Benchmarks coding agents that incrementally extend web applications, with a multimodal web agent testing each version in a live browser; web-app development is the main subject rather than agents operating GUIs.

title: Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Training and Trustworthy Evaluation of DeepSearch Agents
reason: Open recipe for deep-search agents that explore the open web, with verifiable trajectory curation, compaction-aware RL and an anti-leakage plugin for evaluating open-web agents on deep research benchmarks.

title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
reason: Agentic RL with multi-step action forecasting targets, evaluated on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, tau2-bench and AppWorld; the WebShop web environment is one of several settings.

title: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
reason: Agentic RL with Lean4-formalized multi-level process rewards for software-engineering and terminal-usage tasks, reporting TerminalBench results; terminal agents without a GUI.

title: Multimodal Filesystem Memory For Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
reason: Multimodal filesystem memory for long-horizon agents, evaluated on Minecraft and on CUABench-KiCad computer-use tasks; computer use is one of two evaluation settings.

title: Web Agent Agentic Reinforcement Learning Decision Model Under Multi-Cost and Failure Risk
reason: Constrained RL decision model for web agents that balances cost and failure risk on extraction, price comparison, form submission and cross-page navigation tasks.

title: Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay
reason: Training-free experience memory for LLM agents evaluated on SWE-bench Verified plus the WebArena and Mind2Web web-agent benchmarks.

title: fxBench: Evaluating and Understanding Formula Suggestions in Spreadsheets
reason: Benchmark of formula-suggestion tasks on real spreadsheets that studies context selection and formula writing; spreadsheet automation without a GUI agent.

title: From Seeing to Reporting: A Theory of Reliable Visual Set Generation in Vision-Language Models
reason: General theory and inference procedures for VLM visual reporting, applied to counting, detection, screen parsing and GUI grounding with ScreenSpot-Pro results; GUI grounding is a material part of a broader method.

title: Step-Aligned Script Generation with Verification and Recovery for Web Automation Testing
reason: Turns natural-language test intent into verified Playwright end-to-end web test scripts by grounding each step in a live browser, with repair and reversibility-aware backtracking, evaluated on web benchmarks.

title: LoWAgent: A Low-Resource Multilingual Benchmark for Web Agents
reason: Benchmarks web agents on six fully localized websites in English and four low-resource languages, tests robustness to cookie notices and ad pop-ups, and shows that post-training on its traces helps.

title: CUA-Recovery: Benchmarking Error Recovery in Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
reason: Benchmarks error detection and recovery for long-horizon computer-use agents across desktop applications and supplies recovery trajectories for fine-tuning.

title: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
reason: Evaluation framework that injects errors and replays goal-oriented actions to study how keyboard-and-mouse computer-use agents recover from failures.

title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
reason: A meta-agent evolves interfaces and usage knowledge for a computer-use agent, setting an open-source state of the art on OSWorld V2 and improving ScienceBoard.

title: InterWebCoder: Learning Interactive Webpage Generation from Executable Tests via Reinforcement Learning
reason: Trains MLLMs with RL from executable tests to generate interactive webpage code, replacing slow GUI-agent verification; web UI code generation rather than agents operating interfaces.

title: Steering Black-Box Large Language Model Agents with Pitfall Anticipation World Model
reason: Pitfall-anticipating world model that steers black-box LLM agents, evaluated on ScienceWorld and WebArena-Lite.

title: Who Verifies the Agent's Success Claim? Self-Report Leakage in GUI-Agent Completion Judging
reason: Shows that GUI agents' own success reports bias completion judges and builds a claim-blind trace auditor for GUI-agent evaluation.

title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
reason: Capability-centric review that compares computer-use agents with physical embodied agents and robots across 64 benchmarks; computer-use agents are a material part of the framing.

title: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
reason: Live open-web deep search benchmark requiring web search, browser interaction and evidence processing; a browsing research-agent setting.

title: MPIDetector: Detecting Multi-modal Prompt Injection via LLM-based Reasoning
reason: Few-shot LLM detector for textual and visual prompt injections that is also tested on 500 obfuscated environmental web-agent injections from WebInject; web-agent security is one material evaluation.

title: Diagnosing Personalization Failures in Mobile GUI Agents
reason: Diagnostic benchmark for preference personalization in mobile GUI agents, probing how and when preferences should change execution across eleven agent systems.

title: Trace2World: Reconstructing App Worlds from Real Interaction Traces for Scalable GUI Agent Training
reason: Reconstructs executable app environments from real interaction traces for GUI agent RL, with gains on GUI benchmarks and real-device tasks.

title: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
reason: Hierarchical VLA agent that plays Minecraft from vision only with native keyboard-and-mouse actions, including GUI interactions, rather than game APIs.

title: PointerBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Fine-Grained GUI Grounding
reason: Diagnostic GUI grounding benchmark of screenshot-instruction pairs covering spreadsheets, long-text documents and professional applications.

title: Subgoal-aware Memory Graph for GUI Agent
reason: Subgoal-level memory graph that lets mobile GUI agents reuse past trajectories, evaluated on SPA-Bench.

title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
reason: Offline VQA benchmark for VLMs across five agent domains, with web agents as one domain beside robotics, egocentric video, games and spatial planning; errors include localizing UI elements.

title: Understanding Tool-Mediated Interaction Failures in Agentic GUI Software: An Empirical Study
reason: Empirical study and defect library of tool-mediated failures (screenshots, UI trees, action translation) in LLM GUI agent software, with a static contract checker.

title: Reuse, Rewrite, or Reject: Evidence-Constrained Trace Reuse for Repeated Mobile GUI Control
reason: Graph-text templates for selectively reusing execution traces in mobile GUI agents, cutting tokens on AndroidWorld and on real Android and HarmonyOS devices.

title: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
reason: Proposes a GUI agent that gets past CAPTCHA and anti-automation checks by decomposing verification and supervising execution at runtime, evaluated on CAPTCHA families and AndroidWorld.

title: WaitLens: Temporal VLM-Based Adaptive Waiting for Industrial GUI Testing Agents
reason: Fine-tunes a lightweight VLM on GUI loading trajectories to decide when screens are ready, cutting idle waits for industrial GUI testing agents.

title: IGG: A Benchmark for Interactive GUI Grounding under Visibility Constraints
reason: GUI grounding benchmark where agents must scroll, hover, drag or wait to reveal a target before clicking, across 16 controllable GUI environments.

title: SkillShift-Bench: Benchmarking Skill Learning under Environment Evolution for Web Agents
reason: SkillShift-Bench tests web agent skill learning under contextual, perceptual and execution shifts on three self-hosted web systems.

title: Build or Adopt? Custom-Built vs. General-Purpose LLM Agent Harnesses for Automotive GUI Testing
reason: Compares a custom-built harness with general-purpose LLM agent harnesses for GUI testing of Android in-vehicle infotainment systems and public apps, with practitioner interviews.

title: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
reason: Lightweight preprocessor that crops, zooms and adds visual and textual cues to screenshots to improve frozen GUI grounding models across five benchmarks.

title: Seeing the Options: Typed Decisions over Visual Candidates with Reusable Option Memory
reason: Studies how screenshot-element candidates should be encoded for agent action selection, training and testing on Multimodal-Mind2Web and AndroidControl crops, including order invariance and abstention.

title: OS-Wizard: Scaling Computer-Using Agents to Specialized Software via Knowledge-Guided Exploration
reason: Knowledge-guided trajectory collection with a hybrid GUI-code action space for computer-using agents on specialized desktop software, plus fine-tuned models.

title: AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents
reason: Failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld that restores trajectories to error checkpoints, with a recovery reward-modeling benchmark and an offline RL dataset for mobile-use agents.

title: HobbyLM: A Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Model Family on a Hobby Budget
reason: Budget sparse MoE model family report whose post-trained variants include a function-calling and computer-use agent plus a released on-device macOS computer-use adapter.

title: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
reason: Benchmark of reusable verification programs for web agents across four web services, with released states, rules and trajectories.

title: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
reason: Harness-model continual learning that pairs retrievable strategy cards with parameter updates, built for web agents that repeat related multi-step workflows; specific benchmarks are not named.

title: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
reason: Benchmark for personalized mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with a simulated user, testing when to infer from history and when to ask.

title: GUIFlow: Temporal Redundancy-Aware Incremental Inference for GUI Agents
reason: Reuses KV, vision-encoder and prior action states across steps for incremental GUI agent inference, giving up to 3.49x speedup in closed-loop OSWorld runs with comparable task performance.

title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
reason: Benchmarks coding agents revising real applications from multimodal user requests, including UI transformation, graded with source and browser evidence; UI code generation rather than GUI operation.

title: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
reason: Trains a scrollable-region perception model on UI screens so mobile GUI agents know when and where to swipe for hidden targets, raising completion across nine agents.

title: Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents
reason: MiniWeb environment of interconnected websites with skill-labeled browser tasks, generated training trajectories and a planner-executor web agent evaluated on WebArena-Lite, Online-Mind2Web and WebVoyager.

title: When to Intervene? An Empirical Study of Errors and Self-Recovery in LLM Agents
reason: Builds a dataset of computer-use and web agent traces with annotated errors, studies self-recovery and predicts when intervention is needed.

title: Right Click, Wrong Box: Grading GUI Grounding by What a Click Does
reason: Re-grades GUI grounding by executing clicks and comparing their outcomes, auditing ScreenSpot-v2 and live web apps and testing outcome-credited GRPO rewards.

title: AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding
reason: Training-free adaptive zooming with verifier-in-the-loop refinement for GUI grounding, evaluated on OSWorld-G, ScreenSpot-Pro and UI-Vision.

title: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
reason: Mobile GUI agent that picks among candidate actions by scoring JEPA screenshot latents without token decoding, evaluated on AndroidControl.

title: Learning to Look Beyond Screens: Transferable Visual Observation from GUI Grounding
reason: Trains a VLM on GUI grounding trajectories with RL crop-and-inspect steps and studies transfer to general perception benchmarks; GUI grounding is the supervision source rather than the end task.

title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
reason: Theory of how agent policies absorb their harness preferences, tested by post-training on MiniWoB++ web tasks and on coding-agent harnesses in Terminal-Bench Lite.

title: From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
reason: Task advancement memory for GUI agents in long-horizon cross-app workflows, evaluated on MobileWorld and SPA-Bench.

title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
reason: Automatically reconstructs resettable website environments from real URLs for web agent training and evaluation, improving WebArena-Verified success after fine-tuning.

title: AgentHeal: Evaluating Goal-Preserving Resource Recovery of Web Agents under Access Barriers
reason: Benchmark testing whether web agents detect and route around access barriers such as dead links, login walls and anti-scraping defenses, using a sandbox and replayed real websites.

title: Where to Learn and How Far to Roll Out: Efficient Adaptive Training for GUI Agents
reason: Adaptive RL for GUI agents that trains at uncertain pivot checkpoints and widens rollout range, cutting environment interaction on MobileGym and CUA-Gym-Hub.

title: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
reason: Trains iOS UI navigation agents with online PPO using dense LLM-judge rewards and a planner plus UI grounding split, evaluated on UINavBench, iOSWorld and AndroidWorld.

title: What Does "Now" Mean to Your Computer-Use Agent? Stale Screenshots, Page Loads, and Which Check to Run Before a Click
reason: Measures how page loading makes computer-use agents' planned clicks stale on web pages, audits wait rules of open-source agents, and evaluates pre-click checks with a released benchmark generator.

title: InterA11y: Interactive Web Accessibility Error Detection with LLM Agents
reason: LLM agents with rubrics and interactive tools that operate webpages to detect WCAG accessibility errors; agent-driven web testing.

title: DynaRev: Benchmarking Web Agents under Dynamic Goal Revision
reason: Benchmark of 181 web-agent tasks in which user goals change mid-execution, scoring correctness, responsiveness and efficiency and analyzing how browser state is handled.

title: EnvOS: Auditing Computer-Use Agents When the World Moves On : Phenomenon-Based Task Construction, Certification, and Evidence-Based Evaluation
reason: Framework for building and certifying environments that change mid-task to audit computer-use agents, with clinic-booking and claim-approval studies and evidence-based grading checks.

title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
reason: Platform-agnostic verifier for computer-using agents that gathers evidence with GUI or code checks to judge task completion across desktop, mobile and web settings.

title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
reason: Trains a 4B hybrid computer-use agent that combines GUI actions with code and terminal execution on synthesized desktop and web tasks, reaching 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified.

title: AgentShield: Fortifying Web Applications Against AI Agents and Agentic Browsers
reason: Tests agentic browsers against anti-bot defenses, proposes behavioral fingerprinting to detect them, and shows an obstruction-driven attack that erodes web agent safeguards.

title: ANGLER: Verifier-Grounded Benchmarking with an Adaptive Attacker for Web Agents
reason: Builds verifier-grounded red-teaming websites and an adaptive attack-evolution method to measure prompt-injection vulnerability of VLM-based web agents through real state changes.

title: Cross-Interface Authorization for AI Computer-Use Agents
reason: Authorization protocol for computer-use agents acting across GUI, CLI, API, script and MCP routes, preventing alternate-route bypass of security policy.

title: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
reason: Unified computer-use interface letting agents combine code/CLI, accessibility-tree and GUI channels, with AX diff observations, evaluated on OSWorld 2.0.

title: PatchScout: Thematic Web Data Collection via Information Foraging
reason: Multi-agent information-foraging framework that explores the live web to collect thematic document corpora; a web-browsing collection agent rather than GUI operation.

title: MemU-Bench: Benchmarking GUI Agents on Long-Horizon User Interactions
reason: Mobile GUI agent benchmark of vague, history-dependent tasks verified against app databases, plus an app-centric memory framework that recovers missing context across app switches.

title: LADS: Lease-Aware Delivery Scheduling of Tool Results for Language Model Agents
reason: Schedules delivery of bursty browser-action results to a shared inference service with cache leases, cutting web-agent workflow latency; serving infrastructure for web agents rather than an agent method.

title: When 200 OK Is Not an Answer: Silent Fetch Failures in Agentic Web Content Acquisition
reason: Measures silent fetch failures (app shells, bot challenges, block pages) when web agents retrieve pages with static and rendered-browser clients; web-access infrastructure for browsing agents.

title: UI-UG 2: Advancing Mobile UI Understanding and Generation with Fine-Grained Supervision and Reinforcement Learning
reason: Compact MLLM for mobile UI understanding, GUI grounding and DSL-based UI generation, trained on RICO, AITW and AndroidControl data with render-aware online RL.

title: MAPLE: A Multimodal Mobile Agent with Playbook-Learned Experience
reason: Gradient-free multi-agent mobile GUI agent that shares step-wise experience through an evolving playbook, evaluated on AndroidWorld and MobileWorld.

title: Interface Quilt: Modifying Applications with Computer Use Agents and Generative UI
reason: Combines computer-use agents with generative UI to overlay interface patches that change existing applications with no access to their source code or APIs.

title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
reason: Computer-use agent model family trained from large-scale experience with grounding data, SFT and joint desktop-web RL, evaluated on GUI grounding, desktop and web tasks.

title: MAGAR: Multimodal Agents for GUI-Based 3D Mechanical Assembly and Minimal Rework
reason: Benchmark and selective-correction framework for multimodal agents issuing native GUI commands in 3D mechanical assembly software, including minimal-rework recovery.

title: Coati: Host-Grounded Execution for Installable Mobile GUI Agents
reason: Installable on-phone Android GUI agent with host-side action verification, per-app memory and a routed fast executor, evaluated on AndroidWorld.

title: From Local Skills to Long-Horizon Web Tasks: Progressive Skill Exploration for LLM Web Agents
reason: Progressive skill-exploration training for LLM web agents, evaluated on WebArena, WebVoyager and WebShop.

title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
reason: Recursive data-model flywheel that mines workflows from instructional videos to synthesize computer-use trajectories, evaluated on OSWorld Verified and GUI-CLI hybrid benchmarks.

title: ScienceCUA: Resource-to-Skill Construction and Execution-Guided Skill Evolution for Scientific Computer Use Agents
reason: Turns software manuals into reusable skills for computer-use agents on scientific software and evolves them from execution feedback, evaluated on audited ScienceBoard benchmark variants.

title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
reason: WebHarbor offers 153 dockerized reconstructions of real websites with 3,518 tasks for evaluating and RL-training GUI web agents.

title: What Is This Memory Useful For? Measuring Task-Conditioned Utility in Long-Term Agent Memory
reason: Measures task-conditioned utility of stored agent memories, mainly on factual-recall tasks built from LongMemEval-V2 web-agent memories, with coding benchmarks as a contrast.

title: Computer-Use Agents Gain Little Benefit from a World Model When Conditioned on Tutorials
reason: Builds tutorial datasets for OSWorld and ScienceBoard and tests a policy-judge computer-use agent with and without world-model rollouts.

title: Interpretable Early Termination of Web Navigation Agents via Closed Sequential Pattern Mining
reason: Mines failure signatures from MiniWoB++ execution traces so web navigation agents can be stopped early with interpretable reasons.

title: Voluntary Servitude: Weaponized Safety Warning Mechanisms for Controlling AI Agents
reason: Shows that fake hazard warnings planted in reviews steer LLM agents' choices and evade injection detectors, with transfer to production browser agents and to a retrieval pipeline.

title: ScamWorld: An Interactive Environment for Evaluating Web Agents Against Online Fraud
reason: Interactive environment of reconstructed scam websites for testing whether LLM web agents are deceived into payments or credential disclosure during tasks.

title: JHiMA-WebRL: A Joint Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
reason: Jointly trains a task decomposer and a GUI actor with hierarchical GRPO for multimodal web agents in WebArena, evaluated on WebArena-Lite-v2.

title: Can LLM Agents Learn to Test? Maintaining Scoped Experience as Testing Evidence for Mobile GUI Testing
reason: LLM-based mobile GUI testing agent that keeps scoped, revalidated experience such as routes and locators across Android test workflows.

title: Securing Web Agents with the Compile-Then-Execute Paradigm
reason: Compile-then-execute web agent that prevents prompt-injection control-flow hijacking, evaluated on WebArena Verified and the WASP security benchmark.

title: MKD2World: A Typed Spatial MarkDown World Model For Web Agents
reason: Desktop web world model using a typed spatial Markdown UI state representation and a screenshot-annotated dataset; it improves a web agent on Online-Mind2Web.

title: Visual Token Routing: Learning to keep tokens that matter
reason: Learned spatio-temporal routing of screenshot visual tokens for computer-use agents, matching full-resolution performance on OSWorld and CUA-World.
